title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

title: Restaurationsmanager
description:
Restaurationsmanager

Dit Smørrebrød i Skagen er en travl virksomhed i rivende udvikling. 
Vores kendetegn er traditionelt dansk smørrebrød til Skawboer og turister – uden dikkedarer.
Godt gammeldags smørrebrød, klassiske frokost retter samt “Mormor mad” på aftenmenuen, hvor det er lavet fra bunden med friske råvarer – og ”salt, peber og kærlighed”, råvarer af bedste kvalitet samt vores kvalitet og service er ALTID i top.

Vores restaurant emmer af afslappet stemning og maden indtages i hyggelig gammel dansk atmosfære med rød og hvidternede duge. Skagens hyggeligste frokost og aftens restaurant. 

Vi har stor ansvarsfølelse for vores ansatte - vi værdsætter gensidig tillid. Vi løser vores opgaver i fællesskab ved at serverer godt gedigent mad i en afslappet atmosfære, som er fyldt med grin og glæde for så vel ansatte som for vores gæster.

•    Lede og koordinere restaurantteamet under vagterne

•    Koordinere samarbejdet mellem køkken og serveringspersonale
•    Åbne og/eller lukke restauranten samt foretage kasseafstemning
•    Sikre, at restauranten altid fremstår ren, organiseret og klar til service
•    Medvirke til oplæring af nye medarbejdere
•    Løse udfordringer løbende under vagten
•    Stå for varebestilling og lagerstyring

Vi forestiller os, at du

•    Har erfaring fra restaurant- eller servicebranchen
•    Trives med ansvar og kan bevare overblikket i travle perioder
•    Er serviceminded, imødekommende og løsningsorienteret
•    Kan motivere og skabe et godt samarbejde blandt kollegaerne
•    Har fokus på kvalitet og gæsteoplevelser

Vi tilbyder

•    Helårsansættelse
•    Mulighed for bolig
•    Et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor
•    Afslappet omgangstone og godt humør i hverdagen

Restaurant Manager

Dit Smørrebrød in Skagen is a busy restaurant experiencing strong growth.
We are known for serving traditional Danish open sandwiches (smørrebrød) to both local residents and tourists. We pride ourselves on good old-fashioned ‘smørrebrød’, classic lunch dishes, and traditional home-style cooking on our evening menu. Everything is prepared from scratch using fresh ingredients, seasoned with "salt, pepper and love". We use only the finest quality produce, and our standards of food quality and customer service are always second to none.

Our restaurant offers a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere, where guests enjoy their meals surrounded by cosy Danish charm, complete with red-and-white checked tablecloths. We are proud to be one of Skagen's most inviting lunch and dinner restaurants.

We take great responsibility for the wellbeing of our employees and place a high value on mutual trust. We work together as a team to serve honest, wholesome food in a relaxed environment for both our staff and our guests.

Your Key Responsibilities

As Restaurant Manager, you will play a central role in the daily operation of the restaurant.
 Your responsibilities will include:
•    Leading and coordinating the restaurant team during service
•    Allocating tasks and managing staff breaks
•    Ensuring efficient and smooth-running service
•    Welcoming guests and assisting wherever needed
•    Monitoring service quality and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction
•    Handling guest enquiries and any complaints professionally
•    Coordinating communication and cooperation between the kitchen and front-of-house teams
•    Opening and/or closing the restaurant, including cash reconciliation
•    Ensuring the restaurant is always clean, organized, and ready for service
•    Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees
•    Resolving operational challenges as they arise during service
•    Managing stock orders and inventory control

About You

We are looking for someone who:
•    Has experience within the restaurant, hospitality, or service industry
•    Thrives on responsibility and remains calm under pressure during busy periods
•    Is service-minded, approachable, and solution-oriented
•    Can motivate colleagues and foster a positive team environment
•    Has a strong focus on quality and guest experience

We Offer

•    Permanent, year-round employment
•    Accommodation available
•    An informal working environment with plenty of room for good spirits
•    A relaxed workplace culture with a positive atmosphere
•    Some of the happiest guests around, because we serve great food
•    Supportive colleagues who work together as a team
•    A busy, exciting, and enjoyable high season
•    Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Working Hours
Working hours will be scheduled between 10:00 am and 9:00 pm, seven days a week.

Interested?

title: Baker - Bakery Production - Maribo, Lolland, Denmark
description:
Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

Permanent, full-time employment

Pension scheme

5 weeks of vacation

Flexible benefits account

Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with "Baker - Maribo" in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner's job search and settling in Denmark. Read more at https://newcomers.lolland.dk/. You can also find information about working in Denmark at https://www.workindenmark.dk/

title: Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer
description:
Do you want to build computer-vision technology that helps autonomous drones understand and navigate the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, edge computing, software, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for a Senior Computer Vision & AI Engineer to take a leading technical role in developing and improving the perception capabilities behind our drone platform.You will work on challenging real-world problems where robust vision, accurate localisation and reliable performance matter. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys going beyond algorithms and prototypes to build computer-vision solutions that perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.

The role:
You will join a highly technical engineering team working on autonomy for drones and unmanned systems.You will take significant ownership of computer-vision capabilities supporting object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry and other perception-related challenges.You will work closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics colleagues to turn computer-vision concepts into robust, deployable solutions.As a senior engineer, you will also contribute to architecture and technical decisions, help strengthen engineering practices and share your experience with other engineers across the team.

What you will do:
- Design, develop, test and improve advanced computer-vision algorithms for Robotto's drone and autonomy platform.
- Take technical ownership of computer-vision problems from exploration and prototyping through implementation, evaluation and deployment.
- Work with object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM and related perception challenges.
- Build robust solutions that can perform under changing environmental and operational conditions.
- Optimise computer-vision solutions for deployment on edge and resource-constrained computing platforms.
- Define appropriate datasets, test scenarios, evaluation methods and performance metrics.
- Contribute to architecture and technical-design decisions across the perception stack.
- Collaborate closely with software, control, flight-test and electronics engineers to integrate perception capabilities into the wider platform.
- Investigate complex technical issues, validate results and drive practical improvements.
- Contribute to code quality, testing, documentation and engineering practices.
- Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to other engineers where relevant.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's autonomy platform, architecture and computer-vision priorities.
- You have taken ownership of one or more important perception challenges and are driving them towards robust solutions.
- You have contributed meaningful improvements to areas such as object detection, tracking, localisation or visual-inertial odometry.
- Your solutions are being evaluated against real-world data and operational scenarios.
- You are contributing to architecture and technical decisions across the computer-vision stack.
- You are collaborating effectively across computer vision, software, control and flight testing.
- You have become a trusted senior technical contributor within the engineering team.

What we are looking for:
We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong computer-vision foundation and a track record of turning complex technical ideas into practical, working systems.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience preferred, with significant hands-on expertise in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, autonomy or a closely related field.
- Strong practical knowledge of computer vision, with experience in areas such as object detection, tracking, visual localisation, visual-inertial odometry, visual SLAM or related perception methods.
- Strong C++ programming skills, with Python experience for algorithm development, experimentation, testing and prototyping.
- Experience taking computer-vision or machine-learning solutions beyond research and prototyping into real products or deployed systems.
- Experience designing, training and evaluating deep-learning models for computer-vision applications.
- Experience deploying and optimising models or computer-vision algorithms on edge or resource-constrained computing platforms is highly relevant.
- Strong understanding of algorithm evaluation, datasets, testing methodologies and measurable performance criteria.
- Experience contributing to architecture or technical-design decisions within complex software or perception systems.
- A good understanding of how vision systems interact with cameras, sensors, software, compute platforms and real-world environments.
- Experience with drones, robotics, autonomous systems or embedded-adjacent software is a strong advantage.
- Experience mentoring, supporting or sharing technical knowledge with other engineers is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer vision, robotics, computer science, engineering or a related technical field is preferred; equivalent industry or research experience is equally welcome.

Who you are:
You are technically curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership when the answer is not immediately obvious.You enjoy going deep into difficult technical problems, while keeping sight of the goal: building technology that works reliably in the real world.
- You take ownership of technical problems and drive them towards practical solutions.
- You are comfortable making technical decisions and explaining the trade-offs behind them.
- You challenge assumptions constructively and are willing to explore new approaches.
- You care about robustness, testing and measurable performance.
- You collaborate naturally across computer vision, software, control, electronics and flight testing.
- You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others solve difficult technical problems.
- You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve as the company and technology develop.

More information and application:
https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8259919-senior-computer-vision-ai-engineer

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Upholstery Sewer
description:
Work tasks: Automotive and Furniture Upholstery Sewer
(working with genuine leather, faux leather, heavy upholstery fabrics, and Alcantara, and operating heavy-duty industrial machinery). Job Responsibilities ￼ Sewing automotive interior components: Sewing car seat covers, headrests, armrests, door panels, steering wheel covers, headliners, and gear shift/handbrake gaiters. ￼ Creating patterns and templates: Dismantling old covers, assessing wear, and deriving precise new patterns based on them. ￼ Decorative stitching: Executing design stitching (e.g., diamond quilting, double stitching with contrasting thread) and decorative piping. ￼ Adhering to safety requirements: Creating special breakaway safety seams for airbag-equipped seats in accordance with manufacturer standards. ￼ Processing specialized materials: Selecting leather, culling defective pieces, and precision edge thinning (skiving) prior to assembly. ￼ Sewing furniture and cushion covers: Sewing covers for sofas, armchairs, chair seats, headboards, office furniture, and decorative cushions. ￼ Pattern matching and cutting: Precisely positioning and aligning fabric patterns (stripes, checks, large decorative motifs) across different components. ￼ Preparation of edge bindings and piping: Sewing in edge treatments designed to reinforce and decorate furniture edges. ￼ Installation of hardware and fasteners: Sewing on zippers, Velcro strips, buttons, and fastening strips that allow covers to be removed or stretched tight over the frame. ￼ Collaboration with the upholsterer: Checking the fit of covers on the furniture frame and making adjustments if necessary before final stapling. ￼ Material usage planning: Optimizing the layout of fabrics and leathers during cutting to minimize material waste.

We offer: Bee Interior (specializing in exclusive upholstery and interior work for vehicles, watercraft, and furniture) typically offers the following conditions and benefits to its automotive and furniture upholsterers:
Exciting and varied projects: The work is not assembly-line production—every project is unique, ranging from interiors for vintage and luxury cars to motorcycle seats and custom-made furniture. ￼ Competitive pay commensurate with skills ￼ Professional tools and equipment ￼ On-site training and specialization: Support and guidance in executing specific cutting techniques, decorative stitching, and leather preparation. ￼ Stable full-time employment: Long-term job security and a steady workload in a specialized craft sector. ￼ Pleasant work environment: A small, professional, and supportive team that values ​​high-quality craftsmanship.

title: Katlaoperaator
description:
Tööülesanded: Tervitused Sinu tulevaselt juhilt:
"UPM-Kymmene Otepää vineer on looduslik ja kauakestev toode. Kauakestva ja kvaliteetse tootega panustame meie UPM-Kymmene üldisesse missiooni võidelda kliima soojenemise pidurdamisega. Hoolitsedes masinate ja seadmete toimivuse eest, on käigushoiu meeskonnal oluline osa selles missioonis. Meil saad rakendada oma oskusi, arendada end ja olla osa tehase jätkuvas arengus. Oled oodatud meiega liituma, kui oled positiivse ellusuhtumisega, usud, et igal probleemil on lahendus ning väärtustad koostööd.“ – Sander Tamm, Mehhaanika hooldusjuht. Mis saab olema Sinu töö: Sinu peamine ülesanne on tagada katlamaja ja katlasüsteemide ohutu, tõrgeteta ning ökonoomne töö. Täpsemad tööülesanded: - Igapäevane käitamine ja monitooring Seadmete juhtimine: Katelde käivitamine, seiskamine ja võimsuse reguleerimine vastavalt tootmisvajadusele. Parameetrite jälgimine: Rõhu, temperatuuri, veetaseme ja muude oluliste näidikute pidev monitooring mõõteriistade ning automaatikaseadmete abil. Abiseadmete kontroll: Pumpade, ventilaatorite, põletite ja juhtseadmete korrasoleku jälgimine. - Hooldus ja remont Ülevaatused: Regulaarsete visuaalsete ja tehniliste kontrollide läbiviimine rikete ennetamiseks. Korrashoid: Katelde ja seadmete puhastamine, rikete kõrvaldamine ning hooldustööde tegemine. - Ohutus ja aruandlus Alarmidele reageerimine: Häirete ja ohutusalarmide kiire ja asjakohane lahendamine. Avariide ennetamine: Tööohutus- ja keskkonnanõuete järgimine, et vältida ohtlikke olukordi.

Omalt poolt pakume: Head tasupaketti: hea tunnipalk, tulemustasud (kuu ja aasta), transpordi kompensatsioon, erinevaid spordi- ja tervise soodustusi, tööle vastavat tööriietust ja palju muud.
Stabiilsust: stabiilset töösuhet rahvusvahelises edukas ettevõttes; väljaõpet ja jätkuvaid tööalaseid koolitusi ning arenemisvõimalusi. Tähendusrikast tööd: kasevineer on vastupidav, taastuv ja keskkonnasõbralik materjal, mis asendab paljusid fossiilse päritoluga materjale. Meie töö mõjutab ja muudab elukeskkonda. Hoolivat kogukonda: meie kollektiiv on kui kogukond, mis on üles ehitatud suurepärasele meeskonnavaimule ja ühisele pühendumusele. Hoolime üksteisest ja kolleegide heaolust. Toetame oma töötajate töö- ja eraelu tasakaalu. Vastutustundlikku suhtumist: meie tegevuste keskmeks on jätkusuutlikkus ja vastutustundlik tegutsemine. Me hoolime loodusest ja keskkonnast. Me toetame inimeste erisusi ja kaasatust, pakkudes töökeskkonda, milles igaüks saab olla tema ise.

Muud nõuded: Ootame Sind kandideerima kui:
- Sul on tööks sobiv haridus ja/või eelnev töökogemus antud valdkonnas. - Sul on teadmised katelde, auru- ja küttesüsteemide tööpõhimõtetest. - Oled kohusetundlik, õpihimuline ja hea meeskonnatöötaja.

Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring cooks, servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleanliness, occupational health and safety, and general restaurant operating requirements. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

Tööülesanded: Kaubikuga kauba laialivedu päevasel ajal Helsingis ja pärast lõunat Tallinna tagasi (esmaspäeval, kolmapäeval ja reedel töö graafikuga).
Tallinnas kaupade peale laadimine ja meie lattu toomine ja selle jagamine klientide vahel, kauba kvaliteedi ja õigsuse kontrollimine, kaubiku ja laopinna puhtana hoidmine ja koristamine. Kaubikutes ei tohi suitsetada. Kaupade komplekteerimine laos klientidele. Vastavalt vajadusele ka Eestis kaubavedude teostamine. Töö algab ja lõppeb Tallinnas samal päeval.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu õigeaegselt.
Meeldivat töökollektiivi, lõunasöök ettevõtte poolt tööpäevadel nii Soomes kui ka Tallinnas laos, komandeeringu rahasid. Ja muid hüvesid kokkuleppel headele töötajatele. Kõik meie kaubikud on uued ja korralikud.

Muud nõuded: Peab olema täpne, stressi hästi taluv, aus, kohusetundlik, aktiivne, väga tähelepanelik, uusi asju õppiv inimene, alkoholist mitte sõltuv inimene.
Kui tunned, et ei suuda alkoholile "ei" öelda ja ei suuda vara tõusta, siis parem ära kandideeri. Töö on füüsiliselt väga raske, kuna tuleb palju kaubakäruga rasket kaupa laiali vedada. Töö ei sobi kahjuks koolis käivatele inimestele. Kandideerija elukoht võiks olla kas Tallinnas või selle lähiümbruses, kuna töö algab sõidupäevadel hommikul varakult 04:00 laos. Seetõttu on oluline, et kandidaat saaks tööle jõudmise ise korraldada viisil, mis tagab õigeaegse kohaloleku.

description:
Osalise või täiskoormusega

Tööülesanded: - Õppetundide läbiviimine põhikoolis III kooliastmes;
- õpikeskkonna kujundamine; - õppe- ja kasvatustegevuse planeerimine.

Omalt poolt pakume: - Toetavat mentorit ja alustava õpetaja õpiringi tuge, et saaksime võimalikult kiiresti ühiseid töövõite nautida;
- võimalust osaleda kovisioonis, et jagada kogemusi, saada tuge kolleegidelt ja arendada oma professionaalset pädevust; - kooli ümber asuvat suurt õueala, mis pakub häid võimalusi õuesõppeks; - kooli toetust täiend- ja tasemeõppe läbimisel; toetame ka õpetaja kutse taotlemist, kui kandidaadil on mõnes muus valdkonnas magistrikraad olemas; - võimalust ennast haridusuuendustega kursis hoida, osaledes huvitavates koolitustes ja projektides; - ühisüritusi kooliperega, et omavahelist koostööd arendada; - vajadusel kohta kooli ühiselamus, et nautida lühikesi ja mugavaid tööpäeva algusi; - 56 päeva puhkust ja paindlikku töökorraldust jõuluvaheajal, et saaksid töö- ja eraelu sujuvalt ühendada; - täistööaja korral 35-tunnist töönädalat; - 3 tervisepäeva aastas, et saaksid vajadusel puhata ja taastuda ilma haiguslehte vormistamata; - haigushüvitist alates 2. päevast; - kaugemalt tulijatele (üle 50 km) pakume ka sõidukompensatsiooni. Oleme uhked oma õpilaste ning kolleegide üle! Peame lugu igast isiksusest ja püüdleme selle poole, et säilitada ja arendada edumeelseid ning konstruktiivseid suhteid õpilaste, õpetajate ja juhtkonna vahel.

Muud nõuded: Otsime õpetajat:
- kes on inspireeriv ja loov, soovib toetada iga õpilase arengut ning panustada positiivse ja koostöise õpikeskkonna kujundamisse!; - kes on oskuslik suhtleja ning oskab ja suudab siduda õppe loovate ja praktiliste lähenemisviisidega; - kes on ka optimistlik kolleeg ja naudib tööd õpilastega ning oskab koostööd teha oma kaastöötajatega. Meie õpetajad on oma ala professionaalid, pühendunud, rõõmsameelsed ning väärikad! Kui tunned, et tahad panustada meie kooli õpikeskkonda, kus iga õpilane saab realiseerida oma arengupotentsiaali, siis tere tulemast! Meie koolis saad areneda koostöös kolleegidega ja oled osa kasvavast koolikogukonnast.

Work tasks: The main duties of the cook/baker-confectioner include preparing bakery and confectionery products according to instructions and recipes, as well as preparing simple café dishes, including salads and soups.

We expect the employee to be responsible, tidy, accurate and have a positive attitude towards work.

We offer: We offer a position in a new and welcoming café in Tartu city centre and the opportunity to be part of our team from the very beginning.

We value a positive working environment, mutual respect and ensuring that every team member feels comfortable at work. Previous experience as a baker-confectioner or cook is an advantage, but most importantly, we value willingness to learn, responsibility and the desire to do your job well.

title: Office Assistant
description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

Option to work from home: No

title: Office Assistant
description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

title: Senior Server
description:
Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Ryhmäliikunnanohjaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)
description:
**Ryhmäliikunnan ohjaaja MTC:lle, Tampere (Lielahti)**

Etsimme MTC:lle innostavia ryhmäliikunnan ohjaajia, jotka osaa ohjata monipuolisia tunteja, esimerkiksi PUMP, RPV, kehonhuoltoa ja kuntopiirejä. Lisäksi haemme erityisesti myös Pilates ohjaajaa. Jos sinua kiinnostaa, voit halutessasi tehdä myös asiakaspalvelutunteja salillamme.

Valmennuskeskus MTC on matalan kynnyksen liikuntakeskus Lielahdessa, Tampereella. Meillä on lämminhenkinen ja yhteisöllinen meininki: asiakkaamme viihtyvät luonamme, ja moni tulee paikalle myös jutustelemaan, ei vain treenaamaan. Suurin osa asiakkaistamme on keski-ikäisiä ja eläkeikää lähestyviä naisia, joille tärkeintä on arjen toimintakyky ja hyvä olo. Meillä ei siis lasketa kaloreita eikä juosta maratoneja, vaan keskitytään kokonaisvaltaiseen hyvinvointiin ja mukavaan fiilikseen.

Työ koostuu ryhmäliikuntatuntien ohjaamisesta, ja jos kiinnostusta löytyy, mukaan on mahdollista ottaa myös asiakaspalvelua. Ryhmätunnit painottuvat iltapäiviin ja iltoihin, mutta tarjolla on myös aamupäivätunteja.

**Työn alkaminen:** Työ alkaa joustavasti syksyn aikana sopimuksen mukaan.

**Työn muoto:** Alkuvaiheessa työtä tehdään yrittäjänä tai kevytyrittäjänä laskuttaen.

Jos osaat innostaa ryhmää liikkumaan ja haluat olla osa lämminhenkistä ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä, ota yhteyttä ja kerro itsestäsi!

title: ASRO: Jr. Project Manager, space microscope projects
description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Lemminkäisenkatu 46, 20520 Turku

**Application deadline**: 13.10.2026

Are you excited about coordinating complex space projects and growing into a project management role? Join ASRO and help take space instrumentation from development to launch!

**Your role with us**

As a Junior Project Manager at Aboa Space Research (ASRO), you will join the microscope business area and support the project management of space projects. The projects focus on further developing ASROs microscope technology and platform, with missions currently planned for low Earth orbit and the Moon.

Working closely with the Business Area Director, you will help keep multidisciplinary development projects moving forward. Your responsibilities include coordinating schedules and meetings, tracking project actions and deadlines, and ensuring that the documentation and data packages are prepared according to the project requirements and on time.

You will work with experts across mechanics, electronics, software and optics, as well as with ESA, research partners, universities and suppliers. You may also coordinate component purchasing and help maintain project management tools such as Jira. As you gain experience, the role offers room to take on broader responsibilities and grow towards independently managing projects. **What makes you a great fit?**

You might be at the beginning of your career and motivated to grow into a project management professional in a highly technical environment. You enjoy working with people, bringing structure to complex projects and making sure things keep moving forward.

You do not need to be an experienced Project Manager – at least not yet! What matters most is a proactive approach, curiosity toward technical systems, and the confidence to take ownership. You are also comfortable working in a growing and evolving organization, where your role can develop as you gain experience and take on more responsibility.

**We hope you have:**

- A Masters degree in engineering, natural sciences, or another relevant technical field

- Some previous work experience, for example through internships, project work, or other relevant roles.

- Interest in coordinating complex technical projects and keeping schedules, actions and documentation on track

- A proactive and organized working style with the willingness to take ownership and learn

- Good English skills and confidence working with different internal and external stakeholders


**We consider as an asset:**

- Previous exposure to the space industry through studies, projects or work experience is a huge advantage

- Experience in project-based or multidisciplinary engineering environments

- Familiarity with Jira or other project management tools

- Finnish language skills


**What ASRO offers you?**

- Grow into a project management role by taking on real responsibility in ambitious space projects, supported by experienced colleagues.

- Build broad technical understanding by working closely with specialists across mechanics, electronics, software and optics.

- See your work directly support space missions from development and launch all the way to the Moon.

- Shape your responsibilities as you develop, with room to gradually take ownership of increasingly complex project management tasks.

- Flexible working methods and the possibility of partial remote work

- Healthcare insurance as an employment benefit


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time role, and you will be employed directly by ASRO. The position is based at ASROs office in Turku, and regular on-site presence is important for close collaboration with the project teams. Partial remote work is also possible. The role may also include occasional travel, typically a few trips per year depending on the project.

Salary in this position is approximately 3000-4000 €/month, with the final salary determined based on your background, potential, and the amount of relevant expertise you bring to the role. We are also happy to hear about your salary expectations.

**Recruitment process**

- Initial phone interviews with aTalent

- On-site interviews with ASRO


**Interested? Apply now!**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 13th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/386694/create/.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. For more information about ASRO, visit **https://asro.fi/**. For details about the profile & recruitment process, contact Senior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as I can.

title: ASRO: Project Manager, space radiation instrument projects
description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Lemminkäisenkatu 46, 20520 Turku

**Application deadline**: 13.10.2026

Are you ready to take ownership of technically demanding space projects and work closely with customers from development to delivery and beyond? Join ASRO and help bring Finnish space technology to customers around the world!

**Your role with us**

As a **Project Manager** at Aboa Space Research (ASRO), you will take responsibility for projects within ASROs space weather business area. Your focus will be on space radiation instruments, with several ongoing projects ranging from instrument deliveries to concept studies. You can read more about ASROs space weather monitoring solutions here.

You will independently manage typically one to three projects at a time, coordinating the work of multidisciplinary engineering teams and keeping schedules, deliverables, resources, and stakeholders aligned. You will follow project progress, make sure agreed actions move forward, and keep customers up to date throughout the project. Depending on the project, your work may range from managing straightforward instrument deliveries to coordinating more exploratory development where the technical solution is still taking shape.

Your role will also extend beyond traditional project management. You will work closely with customers, ESA, subcontractors and ASROs multidisciplinary engineering teams, with opportunities to contribute to systems engineering and technical development. As projects move from development to delivery, you may also continue working with customers around instrument data and future needs, as well as identify opportunities for follow-up projects. The exact scope can be shaped around your background and strengths.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have experience managing technical projects and are comfortable taking ownership of complex projects involving both engineering teams and external customers. A technical background helps you understand what is happening beneath the project plan and work effectively with specialists across different disciplines.

At the same time, you are not looking for a narrowly defined Project Manager role. ASRO is a small and evolving company, and you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute where your expertise creates the most value. Depending on your strengths and wishes, in the future your role can also develop towards technical product ownership, broader project portfolio project management responsibilities, or a more customer-facing and commercial direction.

**We hope you have:**

- A Masters or PhD degree in engineering, natural sciences, or another relevant technical field

- Ideally, plus five years of relevant professional experience, including experience in project management or technical project environments

- Experience taking ownership of projects and coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams

- A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with engineering specialists and customers

- Good English skills and confidence working with different internal and external stakeholders


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience from the space industry, space instrumentation or other demanding technology environments

- Knowledge of radiation effects, detection technologies, embedded software or data-related solutions

- Experience from product development, product ownership, or bringing technical products into production

- Experience working in a smaller technology company or in customer-facing engineering projects

- Finnish language skills


**What ASRO offers you?**

- Take ownership of ambitious space projects where you can directly influence how projects and customer relationships develop.

- Work with space radiation technology across instrument development, deliveries and emerging data-driven services.

- Use your technical expertise beyond project management, with opportunities to contribute to systems engineering and product development.

- Shape your role in a small organization with minimal hierarchy as ASROs products, customers and business continue to develop.

- Flexible working methods and the possibility of partial remote work

- Healthcare insurance as an employment benefit


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time role, and you will be employed directly by ASRO. The position is based at ASROs office in Turku, and regular on-site presence is important for close collaboration with the project teams. Partial remote work is also possible. The role includes occasional travel to customers and other project stakeholders, typically a few trips per year depending on the projects.

Salary ranges between 4000–6500 €/month, with the final salary determined based on your experience and expertise and your readiness to take independent ownership of space radiation instrument projects. We are also happy to hear about your salary expectations.

**Recruitment process**

- Initial phone interviews with aTalent

- On-site interviews with ASRO


**Interested? Apply now!**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 13th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/386702/create/. In your motivation letter, we would especially like to hear what interested you in this role and ASRO, which aspects of your background and expertise you feel are particularly relevant to the position, and how you would like to develop or shape the role going forward.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. For more information about ASRO, visit **https://asro.fi/**. For details about the profile & recruitment process, contact Senior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as I can.

title: Data and AI Lead for Corporate Sustainability
description:
Are you passionate about data and AI technology — and excited by the opportunity to turn them into real-world sustainability impact?

Were looking for an ambitious and innovative Data & AI professional to work with us in the intersection of AI and corporate sustainability. Youll play a key role as an AI ambassador in building data & AI performance across our business units, from sustainability SaaS and data & AI products to the consultancy business.

If you want to work where data, AI technology, and sustainability meet — and help shape what comes next — wed love to hear from you.

The role

Were looking for a talented and forward-thinking Data & AI Engineer to help shape the next generation of AI-driven sustainability solutions at Ecobio.

Youll work with our data and AI capabilities end-to-end — from reliable data pipelines, integrations, APIs, and data foundations to machine learning, generative AI, and new AI-enabled products and services.

You are a member of our technology team, and you'll work with nature and sustainability experts, and sales to turn environmental and business challenges into scalable, impactful new solutions.

Beyond building technology, youll help shape and implement our AI strategy and practices, introduce emerging technologies, mentor colleagues, and act as an in-house ambassador for responsible and effective AI adoption.

In this role you will grow into technical owner of data and AI products.

At Ecobio, data and AI are tools for creating business value, solving environmental challenges, and protecting nature for future generations.



What you'll do with us

Build our data foundation — design and maintain data pipelines, integrations, APIs, master data, and data quality across our systems.

Develop new production-grade data and AI solutions — including machine learning, generative AI and taking solutions from prototypes to reliable, scalable SaaS features or specific products.

Leverage cloud and emerging technologies — your experience with Microsoft Azure and all related services highly valued. Experience with MLOps, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD in Azure is considered a strong advantage. Experience from AWS or GCP is also relevant.

Enable trusted data and AI — ensuring our data, interfaces, and AI solutions are reliable, governed, and ready for use by customers and our own experts.

Drive automation and innovation — automate data-intensive processes and continuously explore new ways to apply data and AI.

Collaborate with customers and sustainability colleagues — work with product, development, sustainability, and commercial teams to turn needs into technical solutions.
Grow AI capabilities across Ecobio — share knowledge, mentor colleagues as an AI ambassador, and help advance our responsible and ethical use of AI.


What we hope you bring

* University-level education in data engineering or computer science.

* Understanding about modern AI and agentic products.

* Hands-on several years experience with AI/ML or data solutions (idea to production).

* Data engineering experience including ETL, data lakes, master data and data quality.

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

* A learning and innovative mindset — you actively follow developments in data technology and AI.

* A product and customer mindset — you enjoy turning technical capabilities into reliable solutions that create value for customers.

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with confidence working with technical and sustainability colleagues.

* Fluent professional English.

None can do all. If you are confident in any technical issues, and you are a quick learner, please contact us and apply.



What we offer

At Ecobio, youll join a multinational, multidisciplinary team where data technology, AI, and sustainability converge. Youll have the opportunity to grow as an engineer while playing a key role in shaping how data and AI create the future of our products and business.

We offer a full-time position on a skilled, growing team, with our office in Kamppi, Helsinki. We support flexible working hours and remote work, and offer benefits including sports and lunch benefits, as well as a phone benefit.

Your work would start as a key member in our innovative Business Finland project.

Lets work together!



Compensation

The salary range for this position will be discussed during the initial interview. It depends on your background and experience.



How to apply

Please send your application and CV (in Finnish or English) along with your salary expectations by October 15, 2026. We will begin conducting interviews during the application period.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact:

Toni Suominen
Chief Technology Officer
toni.suominen(at)ecobio.fi
Phone: +358 20 765 6146
Available on weekdays 8:00–16:00.

----------------------------------------

We are Ecobio. The Standard in Corporate Sustainability.



We are Ecobio, the Corporate Sustainability Company. We build up the future.

Today, we combine over 35 years of 60 + sustainability expertise with cutting-edge technology to help organisations future-proof their businesses. By connecting sustainability performance with business value, we enable companies to make better decisions, drive meaningful impact, and build a more sustainable future.



At Ecobio, we strive to create a welcoming and supportive workplace where people can do meaningful work and grow. We value trust, collaboration, well-being, and diverse perspectives, believing that our differences make us stronger.



Everyone contributes to our culture, and we encourage you to bring your authentic self, share your ideas, and make an impact as we work together towards a more sustainable future.

Explore more: https://ecobio.fi/en/ [https://ecobio.fi/en/]| LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ecobio-oy [https://www.linkedin.com/company/ecobio-oy]

title: Lähihoitaja, Pispan kotihoito
description:
Pispan kotihoidon moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistä arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä. Kotihoidon tavoitteena on edistää asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaista perusturvallisuutta, kuntoutumista sekä arjessa selviytymistä. Pitkät hoitosuhteet ovat arvokkaitta sekä asiakkaille että hoitajille.

Lähihoitajana teet tärkeää työtä kohdatessasi asiakkaan hänen omassa kodissaan ja mahdollistamalla hänen selviytymisensä arjessa. Työsi on itsenäistä, liikkuvaa ja päivät ovat erilaisia. Kotihoidossa tehtäviisi kuuluu mm. lääkehoito, kirjaaminen sekä muut monipuoliset ja ihmisläheiset hoito- ja hoivatyöt. Jokapäiväisessä käytössämme on myös työtä tukevaa teknologiaa, kuten lääkeautomaatteja ja kuvapuhelimia.

Miksi hakea meille?
Saat meillä hyvän perehdytyksen sekä tuen työkavereilta ja esihenkilöltä.
Pystyt vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi, jotta vapaa-ajan ja työn yhdistäminen olisi mutkatonta.
Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut kuten vuosittaisen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassilla, työnantajan lounasedun ja tyhy- sekä Virkisty Vapaalla ry:n toimintaa.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?
Olet nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja (sosiaalihuolto).
Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea.
Sinulla on B-luokan ajokortti, auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Käytössämme on leasing-autoja ja sähköpyöriä helpottamaan kulkemista asiakaskohteidemme välillä.
Sinulla on LOVe - lääkehoidon verkkotesti suoritettuna hyväksytysti (LOVe LOP, PKV, KIPU1, GER 1). Tarvittaessa voit suorittaa lääkehoidon osaamisen myös työpaikalla, heti työsuhteen alussa.
Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta sekä RAI-osaamisen.
Sinulla on hyvät työyhteisötaidot, toimit oma-aloitteisesti ja joustavasti.

Aloitus vakituisessa tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Jätä rohkeasti hakemuksesi ja liity Pispan rempseään ja huumorilla höystettyyn osaavaan tiimiin, joka ottaa avoimesti vastaan uusia työntekijöitä! Haastatteluun kutsuttaviin hakijoihin olemme yhteydessä henkilökohtaisesti.

title: Running Gear Component Expert

* Good written and spoken communication skills in both English and Finnish
