title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

description: Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico COLLABORA CON C.A.B.I. Cattaneo SPA, azienda che opera dal 1936 a Milano nel campo dei veicoli subacquei e dei sistemi subacquei speciali per la Marina Militare. Progetta, realizza e mantiene in efficienza i prodotti durante l'intero ciclo di vita, gestendone anche l'integrazione con nuovi sistemi per il continuo ammodernamento. Ti occuperai di: - Montare e collaudare parti di gruppi motore e propulsori nuovi, verificando tolleranze secondo le specifiche costruttive; - Allestire e installare gruppi meccanici ed elettromeccanici su imbarcazioni, coordinando l'integrazione con la struttura dello scafo; - Revisionare e riparare motori e propulsori usati: smontaggio, controllo dimensionale, sostituzione componenti critici, minimizzando i tempi di fermo; - Preparare e attrezzare componenti motoristici personalizzati, con o senza disegno tecnico, per rispondere a esigenze operative specifiche; - Integrare impianti idraulici e pneumatici a bordo, ottimizzando i sistemi fluidici e verificandone la tenuta e la funzionalità; - Diagnosi di guasti e anomalia, con conseguente manutenzione programmata, ordinaria e straordinaria, di motori e sistemi propulsivi, garantendo affidabilità e longevità nel ciclo di vita del mezzo; - Eseguire il collaudo funzionale dell'allestimento post-installazione, verificando la conformità alle specifiche tecniche e alle normative applicabili; - Redigere la documentazione tecnica degli interventi eseguiti; Must have: - Diploma ad indirizzo meccanico, meccatronico, aeronautico; - Esperienza minima di almeno 4 anni in ruoli analoghi di montaggio meccanico; - Ottima capacità di lettura del disegno meccanico; - Buona capacità di lettura di schemi elettrici base; Nice to have: - Preferibile conoscenza base della lingua inglese tecnica; - Esperienza specifica su motori endotermici per applicazioni navali, - Buona conoscenza del pacchetto Office; title: conduttore di macchine per la trafila di metalli/conduttrice di macchine per la trafila di metalli
description: Hai esperienza come tecnico elettrico? Cerchi una nuova opportunità lavorativa in cui mettere in pratica le tue competenze tecniche? Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico COLLABORA CON C.A.B.I. Cattaneo SPA, azienda che opera dal 1936 a Milano nel campo dei veicoli subacquei e dei sistemi subacquei speciali per la Marina Militare. Progetta, realizza e mantiene in efficienza i prodotti durante l'intero ciclo di vita, gestendone anche l'integrazione con nuovi sistemi per il continuo ammodernamento. Cerchiamo la figura di CABLATORE/MONTATORE ELETTRICO che si occuperà di montaggio, cablaggio, messa a punto e collaudo dei gruppi elettrici ed elettronici dei nostri sistemi subacquei. Quali saranno le tue attività? - Esegue in autonomia i processi di montaggio e cablaggio durante l'allestimento dei gruppi secondo gli standard qualitativi di processo, segnalando eventuali difetti e possibili miglioramenti al proprio responsabile - Mette a punto elettricamente ed elettronicamente i sottogruppi assemblati, ottimizzando l'integrazione ed il funzionamento dei sistemi. - Analizza il guasto di natura elettrica ed elettronica e ripara i gruppi sottoposti a riparazione e/o revisione. - Allestisce banchi prova elettrici ed elettronici per il collaudo dei gruppi assemblati e assiste la conduzione della sala prova su motori termici ed elettrici, secondo specifiche tecniche o istruzioni operative. - Controlla la qualità e conformità dei materiali di acquisto (parte elettrica) e compila la documentazione di competenza di qualità e di produzione. Must have: - Diploma tecnico (perito elettrotecnico, elettronico o indirizzo affine) o formazione equivalente. - Esperienza pregressa in mansione analoga: montaggio e cablaggio di gruppi o quadri, ricerca guasti e riparazione. - Ottima manualità nella saldatura a stagno di componenti elettronici e capacità di eseguire saldature pulite, lucide e prive di difetti - Conoscenza del disegno e delle normative tecniche: lettura di schemi elettrici e distinte di cablaggio. - Disponibilità a brevi trasferte Nice to have: - Qualifica PES/PAV secondo la norma CEI 11-27 per i lavori elettrici (art. 82, D.Lgs. 81/2008). title: Database and network professionals
description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni. Ci ha incaricati di ricercare un/a Senior Pre Sales Engineer - Networking che verrà inserito/a all'interno della Technology Unit NDCS della Business Unit PPS (Public & Private Sector) e opererà nell'area di Prevendita, contribuendo alla definizione di soluzioni innovative in ambito Networking, Data Center, Security e Cloud per clienti Enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. L'obiettivo del ruolo è supportare le strutture commerciali nella qualificazione delle opportunità, nella progettazione delle soluzioni e nella predisposizione delle offerte tecnico-economiche, collaborando con vendor, partner e team di delivery. Competenze tecniche richieste - Architetture IP Enterprise e Service Provider. - Routing e switching (OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Segment Routing). - Tecnologie LAN, WAN e Data Center. - Esperienza su soluzioni Cisco, HPE ed altri vendor. - SD-WAN e SDN. - Wireless Enterprise. - Cloud e Network Security. - Processi ITIL e Service Management. Requisiti - Esperienza di almeno 8-10 anni in attività specifiche nel ruolo di cui al profilo richiesto - Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni complesse. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. - Disponibilità a trasferte. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

perkame juodųjų ir spalvotųjų metalų laužą Lietuvoje, parduodame perdirbėjams ir eksportui per Klaipėdą. Ieškome vadybininko, kuris veda sandorį nuo tiekėjo iki pirkėjo ir atsako už jo maržą.
Uždarbis – bazinė dalis ir komisiniai nuo sandorio maržos.

Pirkimo pusė.

Tiekėjų paieška: metalo apdirbimo ir gamybos įmonės, statybos ir demontavimo objektai, laivų
remontas, transporto aikštelės, savivaldybių įmonės.
Objektų apžiūra vietoje: kiek medžiagos, kokios rūšies ir būklės, ar ją reikės pjaustyti, kaip bus
kraunama.
Kainos pasiūlymas pagal medžiagos rūšį ir tos dienos kainoraštį.
Susitarimas dėl konteinerio ar mašinos pastatymo, pakrovimo laiko ir svėrimo vietos.
Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.
Pardavimo pusė
Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.
Sandorio vedimas
Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.
Regionas
Pasiteisinus pirmiems rezultatams – naujo regiono atidarymas ir jo tiekėjų tinklo formavimas.

title: IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Job Location:  LUXEMBOURG
Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in the domain of IoT communication connectivity and associated services. We are a venture capital-backed company with a successful track record of satellite launches and the first company in the world to disrupt the telecommunications industry by merging cellular 5G with satellites.
Our technology has massive implications for the Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport sectors, particularly in the management and tracking of assets in remote and rural areas and in extending 5G coverage through non-terrestrial networks.
As our wireless technologies continue to evolve and earn multiple awards, with funding for the next phase secured and strong commercial traction demonstrated, we are now looking to onboard an experienced IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator to strengthen and manage our cloud-first IT infrastructure.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing and supporting our modern IT environment across Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and virtualization platforms, ensuring the security, availability, scalability, and reliability of our systems. You will play a key role in maintaining a secure, resilient, and well-documented infrastructure, driving infrastructure modernization initiatives, supporting users across the organization, and enabling the continued growth and success of OQ Technology.

Job Responsibilities

• Administer and support all types of endpoints (Windows, Mac, Linux, and mobile) across the organization.
• Manage and support Microsoft Azure cloud services, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, conditional access, backups, and monitoring.
• Manage identity, access, and device management (Entra ID, Intune, MDM).
• Support secure collaboration tools (Microsoft 365, file sharing, conferencing), SharePoint Online administration, and licensing management (including CSP/NCE transitions).
• Maintain and optimize virtualization platforms (Proxmox or other hypervisors) and containerized environments where applicable.
• Manage and support AWS infrastructure, including provisioning, monitoring, and maintaining EC2 instances and related resources.
• Handle user and access management on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Support and maintain secure remote access (OpenVPN, bastion hosts, jump servers) and general network infrastructure (switches, firewalls, VLANs, routing).
• Support system availability, performance, patching, and lifecycle management across cloud platforms.
• Manage backup and disaster recovery operations using Veeam, ensuring reliable backup jobs, retention policies, and recovery testing.
• Maintain and support self-hosted or cloud-based GitHub/GitLab instances, including user access, repository administration, and general upkeep.
• Apply security-by-design principles across all IT systems; support compliance with relevant standards (e.g. ISO 27001) and internal security policies.
• Assist with vulnerability management, patching, audits, and risk assessments.
• Participate in infrastructure planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
• Troubleshoot complex system and virtualization issues across cloud environments.
• Provide Level 2/3 escalation support for the helpdesk team and end users.
• Document system configurations, procedures, architectures, and operational standards.
• Manage IT-related purchases (hardware, software licenses, cloud credits) in collaboration with procurement, and track asset lifecycle to optimize spend.
• Develop working knowledge of Linux systems and assist with Linux-based workloads as needed.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience as a Systems Administrator or in a comparable IT infrastructure/operations role in a corporate environment.
• Strong hands-on experience with Azure/Microsoft 365 administration (Entra ID, SharePoint Admin Center, conditional access, licensing).
• Solid understanding of virtualization concepts (Proxmox, Hyper-V, or similar).
• Experience managing AWS resources (EC2 instances and related services); familiarity with GCP user/access management is a plus.
• Solid networking knowledge, including OpenVPN administration, switches, firewalls, VLANs, and routing (TCP/IP).
• Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and system monitoring solutions (Veeam experience is a strong plus).
• Comfortable working with enterprise ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk) for incident and request management.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a preference for clear, GUI-driven administration tools where practical.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Excellent documentation skills — comfortable producing clear operational guides and handover documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting or administering Linux systems, or strong willingness to learn.
• Familiarity with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, or comparable) as a complement to GUI-based administration.
• Exposure to containerization (Docker) and infrastructure automation tools (Ansible, Terraform).
• Familiarity with maintaining GitHub/GitLab instances (user management, repository administration).
• Experience working within an international organization, comfortable navigating diverse cultures and multiple time zones.
• Relevant certifications (Microsoft, Azure) are a plus.

Additional Information:

As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What We Offer

• A hands-on role with ownership across the full cloud IT stack and security.
• Direct exposure to infrastructure modernization and licensing/procurement decisions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

title: Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Job Location:  LUXEMBOURG
Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT connectivity and next-generation satellite communication services. As a venture-backed company with a proven track record of satellite launches, we are the first in the world to integrate cellular 5G with satellites, enabling seamless connectivity for devices in remote and underserved regions. Our technology supports transformative applications across industries such as Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport, extending reliable connectivity through Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN). To support the continued development of our advanced telecommunications platform, we are looking for a Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of 3GPP-based protocol stacks and NTN adaptations for NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies, helping bring cutting-edge satellite connectivity solutions from research to real-world deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Contribute to the research, development, and adaptation of L1/L2/L3 protocol stack components for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) supporting NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies.
• Participate in the full R&D lifecycle, including system design, implementation, integration, testing, and performance optimization.
• Analyze, troubleshoot, and enhance protocol stack behavior across multiple layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS.
• Investigate and implement NTN-specific adaptations required for satellite communications, including aspects related to propagation delay, Doppler effects, and timing synchronization.
• Design and execute testing and validation procedures, including unit testing, system integration testing, and performance benchmarking.
• Contribute to software integration and deployment workflows, including continuous integration and version control practices.
• Stay up to date with 3GPP standardization developments (e.g., NTN features in Releases 17/18/19) and contribute to translating standards into practical implementations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including RF, FPGA, satellite systems, and platform engineering to integrate telecom stacks with hardware and system components.
• Support system-level analysis and debugging, including log analysis, KPI evaluation, and protocol trace inspection.

Basic qualifications

• An academic degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in telecom R&D, preferably working with 3GPP-based wireless systems.
• Solid understanding of 3GPP protocol architecture and procedures in NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, with additional scripting experience in Python for automation and analysis.
• Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with standard development and debugging tools.
• Familiarity with software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices. • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex system-level issues.
• Good communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.
• IMPORTANT: Candidate must already reside in Europe or hold a valid European residence permit.

Preferred skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with 3GPP wireless systems, particularly NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR implementations.
• Experience working with NTN architectures and protocol adaptations defined in 3GPP specifications.
• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).
• Familiarity with core network signalling protocols, such as S1AP, NGAP, and GTP-C/U.
• Experience working with software-defined radio platforms (e.g., USRP) or open telecom stacks such as srsRAN and OpenAirInterface, or Open5GS and free5GC.
• Knowledge of O-RAN architecture and functional split concepts.
• Familiarity with Small Cell Forum (SCF) interfaces, including FAPI/nFAPI.
• Background in embedded or real-time software development, particularly on ARM-based or heterogeneous platforms.
• Experience with protocol debugging, KPI analysis, and system performance optimization in wireless communication systems.

Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What we offer:

• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary – an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

title: OPERATEUR AMIANTE F/H
description:
Fort des compétences de sa filiale de démolition XARDEL, acquise en 2011, le Groupe COSTANTINI est en mesure de réaliser tous types de travaux de démolition et de déconstruction sélective, jusqu'au tri et la revalorisation des matériaux.


Avec un parc matériel spécifique de plus de 30 machines et une équipe d'opérateurs confirmés, nous sommes capables de proposer des solutions techniques à des démolitions d'immeubles de plus de 30 mètres de hauteur, des ouvrages d'art de tous types, des usines, des maisons individuelles ou même des démolitions intérieures pour réhabilitation.


Nous sommes également en mesure de réaliser des travaux de désamiantage intérieurs ou extérieurs dans le cadre de nos opérations.


La démolition est un métier technique et parfois complexe. Nous avons le savoir-faire et les moyens techniques pour vous accompagner dans vos travaux futurs.


Pour renforcer son équipe de Niederkorn (LU), XARDEL recherche un Opérateur Amiante F/H


Responsabilités :


L'Opérateur Amiante F/H effectue le retrait des matériaux amiantés en respectant strictement les consignes de la hiérarchie.

Voici vos missions :

    Mettre en place les installations de chantier (balisage, confinement, dépression, SAS) et préparer le terrain, les outils, les matériaux nécessaires à l'exécution des travaux,

    Réaliser les travaux de retrait des matériaux contenant de l'amiante dans le respect du plan de retrait établi,

    Repérer, séparer et enlever les différents matériaux : bois, métaux, bardages, déchets inertes (plastique, revêtement) sous la directive du chef de chantier,

    Effectuer les opérations de décontamination (personnelle, matériels, zones) en respectant les consignes de sécurité,

    Assurer le conditionnement, l'étiquetage et l'évacuation des déchets amiantés,

    Renseigner les documents de suivi de chantier (traçabilité, rapports) et rendre compte à la hiérarchie de l'avancement des travaux,

    Utiliser et entretenir les appareils de protection respiratoire et les équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) et collective (EPC).


Compétences requises :

    Connaissance des risques liés à l'amiante (toxicité, pathologies associées, réglementation),

    Lecture et compréhension des modes opératoires (plan de retrait, notice de poste, procédures SS4),

    Savoir reconnaître les matériaux susceptibles de contenir de l'amiante,

    Respect strict des consignes de sécurité (EPI, confinements, décontamination),

    Capacité à utiliser le matériel spécifique (aspirateurs à filtration absolue, unités de décontamination, équipements de confinement),

    Communication et remontée d'informations (alerte en cas de situation à risque),

    Habile de ses mains, disponible et doté·e d'une bonne résistance physique.


Compétences utiles :

    La possession d'ACS/CACES engins de chantier et/ou d'une formation amiante SS3 ou SS4 est considérée comme un atout,

    Connaissance des normes de sécurité.


Nous offrons :

    Un poste à pourvoir immédiatement dans une entreprise dynamique et en pleine croissance,

    Rémunération selon profil et expérience,

    Mutuelle Santé obligatoire et prise en charge à 100%,

    Parcours de formation

title: Senior Unified Communications Engineer — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (H/F) — CDI à temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions ? XXXX Group est à la recherche d'un Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées pour concevoir, déployer et supporter des environnements de téléphonie Cisco et Microsoft Teams avancés pour ses clients.

Mission

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Cisco & Applications de XXXX S.A. en tant qu'ingénieur senior, et prendrez en charge les solutions de Communications Unifiées Cisco et Microsoft Teams sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie — de l'architecture et la conception jusqu'à l'implémentation et le dépannage avancé.
Vous serez le référent technique et le point d'escalade pour les projets et incidents complexes, en intervenant à la fois sur nos propres plateformes et sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région, dans un environnement professionnel exigeant nécessitant rigueur, autonomie, sens du service et bonne gestion des priorités.

Rôle principal

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à:  

• Concevoir des solutions de communications unifiées (Cisco UC, SIP, Microsoft Teams) adaptées aux besoins des clients, en produisant des dossiers d'architecture de haut et bas niveau (HLD/LLD).
• Piloter l'implémentation et le déploiement des solutions UC:  clusters CUCM, passerelles voix, SBC/CUBE, trunks SIP, téléphones IP Cisco, Jabber/Webex, messagerie vocale et téléphonie Microsoft Teams.
• Définir et construire les plans de numérotation, le routage d'appels, les plans de numéros et les politiques de classe de service sur plusieurs sites.
• Agir comme point d'escalade de niveau 3:  diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents complexes voix, réseau et UC.
• Prendre en charge la sécurité UC:  certificats et PKI, TLS/SRTP, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL, clusters en mixed-mode) et prévention de la fraude téléphonique (toll fraud).
• Intégrer la UC à l'écosystème environnant:  AD/LDAP, présence, messagerie vocale, supervision et outils de ticketing.
• Piloter les migrations et montées de version, y compris les scénarios Cisco vers Teams et de téléphonie hybride.
• Assurer un leadership technique et le mentorat des techniciens et ingénieurs juniors, et contribuer aux bonnes pratiques internes.
• Assurer l'interface avec les clients, les fournisseurs et les équipes internes, en garantissant la qualité, une communication claire et le respect des délais projet.
• Produire et maintenir une documentation technique claire (dossiers de conception, configurations, as-built et procédures d'exploitation).

Profil recherché

Titulaire d'un diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur en informatique, réseaux ou télécommunications (niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5), ou justifiant d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente, vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans des projets de communications unifiées, dans un rôle combinant conception, implémentation et support.
Vous avez une capacité avérée à concevoir une solution, à l'implémenter et à la dépanner de bout en bout, et vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler en autonomie dans un environnement structuré et orienté client, avec un haut niveau d'exigence. Vous savez gérer les priorités et garder une communication professionnelle et claire en toute circonstance.
Les certifications Cisco (CCNP Collaboration / CCIE Collaboration) sont fortement appréciées ; les certifications Microsoft (Teams / Microsoft 365) sont un plus.

Compétences

• L'expertise Cisco Unified Communications est obligatoire : connaissance approfondie de CUCM, Unity Connection, IM&P, Jabber, Webex, téléphones IP Cisco, passerelles voix et SBC/CUBE.
• Maîtrise approfondie du protocole SIP (signalisation, négociation SDP, dépannage) et des flux média RTP/SRTP.
• Solides connaissances en sécurité UC et gestion des certificats: TLS, SRTP, PKI et gestion des certificats, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL), clusters en mixed-mode et lutte contre la fraude téléphonique.

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams

- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg

title: SENIOR LINUX ENGINEER (m/f)

description:

·        Contribute to IT asset, software and configuration-management activities, where applicable.
·        Follow emerging technologies and propose improvements to infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.

·        User accounts, access rights, authentication and permissions, in accordance with internal policies.
·        Virtualised and containerised environments using technologies such as VMware, Proxmox, Docker, Podman and Kubernetes.
·        Compute, storage, backup and high-performance-computing environments supporting research and organisational workloads.
·        Environments within public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure and Scaleway.


Project delivery and activity management

In addition to day-to-day engineering and operational support, you will contribute to IT and infrastructure projects delivered through internal initiatives and in collaboration with external partners or clients.

Depending on the assignment, you may also coordinate or manage IT or LIST-level projects involving multidisciplinary teams.

Education
·        Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field experience

Experience and skills

·        6–7 years of professional experience in Linux system administration, infrastructure operations or a comparable IT environment.
·        Strong practical experience administering Linux servers and endpoints, including system configuration, performance monitoring, patch management, troubleshooting and lifecycle maintenance.
·        Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration-management tools such as Ansible or Puppet, and scripting for operational tasks.
·        Experience with endpoint management, software deployment and configuration-management tools such as ManageEngine Endpoint Central is an advantage.
·        Good understanding of infrastructure-security practices, including system hardening, access control, vulnerability remediation, encryption, endpoint protection and data protection.
·        Experience monitoring infrastructure availability, capacity and performance, and responding to incidents and service requests.
·        Familiarity with IT service-management practices, including incident, problem, change, release, backup, recovery and business-continuity management.
·        Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls and secure remote access.

title: Teacher French Language B (DP and MYP) (m/f) - 6 months contract
description:
DP (Diploma Programme) and MYP (Middle Years Programme) French Language B - 6 months contract (2627-037)

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

Join Our Learning Community at ISL!

Do you believe that every learner has unique potential, and that education should nurture curiosity, critical thinking, and global awareness? Are you passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences that empower students to make sense of the world and their place in it? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

As a teacher in our school, you will play a key role in shaping not only what our students learn, but how they learn. You'll design engaging, concept-driven lessons that invite curiosity, encourage reflection, and challenge students to connect learning to their own lives — locally and globally. Teaching in our Upper School means that you will be expected to take part in the student wellbeing / advisory programme.
Why ISL?

At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:

· Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
· Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
· Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future

About the Role

At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. We are currently seeking a passionate and reflective French Language B Teacher - Diploma Programme (DP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP)- to join our vibrant learning community in Luxembourg.

As a French Language B Teacher, you will guide students in developing their language acquisition skills and intercultural understanding through the IB DP and MYP frameworks. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for a teacher who sees teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What You'll Do

As our French Language B Teacher, you will:

· Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences in French Language B across DP and MYP
· Collaborate with colleagues to design interdisciplinary, concept-based, and innovative learning experiences
· Teach and support learners in developing French language acquisition, communication skills, and intercultural understanding
· Create inclusive, differentiated learning environments that support diverse learners
· Foster learner agency, voice, and ownership of learning
· Use assessment and feedback intentionally to guide progress and growth of learners
· Build strong, respectful relationships with learners that promote wellbeing and a sense of belonging
· Using a Learning Management System to organize course materials, support collaboration, and engage students.
· Contributing to the wellbeing and pastoral life of the school, including serving as a student advisor.
· Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
· Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
What will you bring?

Essential:

● Experience teaching IB DP French Language Acquisition and/or MYP French Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in French appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.

Valued Experience:

● Experience preparing students for IGCSE assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.

We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.

title: Opérateur(trice) de production agroalimentaire (H/F/X)
description:
Description de tâches:

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

CDI – Temps plein – Kleinbettingen (Luxembourg)
Rejoignez un acteur industriel engagé de l'alimentation européenne
Entreprise familiale indépendante fondée au Luxembourg, Les Moulins de Kleinbettingen est un acteur reconnu de la transformation céréalière en Europe.
Depuis onze générations, nous développons un savoir-faire solide dans la fabrication de produits destinés à l'alimentation humaine: farines, semoules, mixes et solutions alimentaires à destination des artisans, industriels et de la grande distribution.

Notre développement repose sur trois piliers essentiels:  qualité – innovation – respect des ressources naturelles

Dans le cadre du développement de nouvelles activités industrielles, nous renforçons nos équipes afin d'accompagner notre croissance et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence sur l'ensemble de nos lignes de fabrication.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

Votre mission:

Intégrez une équipe dynamique et participez activement à la fabrication de produits agroalimentaires de qualité.
Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.
• Effectuer le suivi des paramètres de production et signaler toute anomalie.
• Veiller au respect des objectifs de production, de qualité et de rendement.
• Réaliser les changements de production selon les procédures établies.

Contrôle qualité

• Effectuer les contrôles horaires des produits en cours de fabrication.
• Réaliser et enregistrer les résultats des contrôles dans le système de gestion de la qualité.
• Prélever des échantillons et effectuer des analyses simples au laboratoire de production:
• Identifier les écarts de qualité et informer la hiérarchie en cas de non-conformité.

Gestion des matières premières

• Assurer le vidage et l'approvisionnement des matières premières nécessaires à la production.
• Contrôler la disponibilité et la conformité des matières utilisées.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de matières premières selon les procédures en vigueur.

Packaging et préparation de commandes

• Réaliser les opérations de conditionnement et d'emballage des produits finis.
• Vérifier la conformité de l'étiquetage et du conditionnement.
• Préparer les commandes selon les instructions de production et les exigences clients.
• Assurer la traçabilité des produits emballés.

Entretien et nettoyage

• Effectuer le nettoyage régulier des équipements, des postes de travail et des zones de production.
• Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de nettoyage en vigueur.
• Participer aux opérations de maintenance de premier niveau.

Conditions particulières

• Travail posté selon les besoins de la production.
• Port des équipements de protection individuelle obligatoire.
• Respect strict des procédures qualité, sécurité et hygiène.

Perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste offre une réelle perspective d'évolution vers une fonction de Chef d'équipe Production.
Selon votre engagement, votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à coordonner les activités de production, vous pourrez progressivement évoluer vers un rôle à responsabilités comprenant:

• Encadrement opérationnel d'une équipe de production
• Organisation et suivi des plannings de fabrication
• Coordination des changements de production
• Support technique et organisationnel aux opérateurs
• Contribution active à la performance globale de la ligne

Un accompagnement interne et des formations pourront être proposés afin de soutenir cette évolution.

Compétences requises

• Formation technique, industrielle ou agroalimentaire (ou expérience équivalente)
• Une première expérience en production est un atout, mais non obligatoire

Job Description:  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.

Purpose of the Role

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.
• Perform regular risk reporting activities, including contribution to Annex IV reporting, escalation of breaches or anomalies, and maintenance of accurate risk data within risk management systems.
• Contribute to the enhancement of risk management processes, systems, and operational procedures by identifying practical improvements and supporting the implementation of efficient and scalable solutions
• Responsible of the accuracy and timeliness in the production of risk assessment, analysis and reporting including annex IV.
• Perform the monitoring of investment compliance of the AIFs
• Support the development and enhancement of internally developed risk IT tools, including testing of new reporting solutions, data aggregation processes, controls, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics and reporting.

Client management

• Serve as a key contact for clients on risk management matters, ensuring appropriate escalation of relevant issues to senior members of the permanent risk management function. Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Stakeholder Engagement

Attributes/Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of alternative investment fund risk management frameworks for liquid and illiquid strategies.
• Understanding of AIFMD regulatory requirements and Annex IV reporting obligations.
• Experience with risk monitoring tools, limit management systems, and risk reporting applications Knowledge of market, liquidity, counterparty, leverage, and operational risk measurement methodologies.
• Ability to analyse and interpret portfolio risk metrics and exposure reports.

• Exposure to user acceptance testing (UAT) and enhancement of internally developed risk systems and reporting tools
• Good command of Excel and risk reporting tools; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or data visualisation tools would be an advantage
• Understanding of fund structures, valuation processes, and delegated portfolio management oversight within an IFM/AIFM environment
• Ability to identify control gaps and contribute to process improvement initiatives in a regulated environment.

Relevant Experience

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),

Direction Générale


Contexte de l'entreprise:

Dans le cadre de la réorganisation opérationnelle et du futur départ de notre actuelle Directrice Administrative d'ici fin 2026, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Administratif et Financier.

Dans notre environnement d'entreprise multiculturel (allemand, français, luxembourgeois) d'installation et maintenance HVAC, ce poste combine des fonctions de pilotage opérationnel, de contrôle de gestion rigoureux et de supervision transversale.


Missions et Responsabilités Clés:

Le/la RAF aura la responsabilité de superviser les quatre grands piliers de notre administration :

1. Management Général et Opérationnel

Assurer le pilotage de l'organisation administrative globale et le support au quotidien (informatique, événements, parc automobile, matériel).
Manager l'équipe de l'administration : piloter la répartition des tâches, assurer la montée en compétences et gérer les absences et suppléances.
Optimiser et digitaliser les processus internes, résoudre les problématiques inter-services et faire remonter (escalader) les points bloquants à la direction.
Fournir un support opérationnel à la direction générale par la préparation d'analyses, d'évaluations et de bases de décision.

2. Contrôle de Gestion, Finance & Audit

Piloter le contrôle de gestion des projets : analyser les écarts (coûts/recettes/marges), réviser les prévisions, valider les durées de projets et contrôler les coûts post-clôture.
Assurer l'interface entre la finance et le métier : aligner les données de la comptabilité avec la gestion de projet, et suivre les flux de trésorerie (garanties bancaires, retenues de garantie).
Coordonner de manière centrale l'audit financier avec notre auditeur externe (pré-audit de novembre et audit final en mars-avril), préparer les dossiers et justifier les données.

3. Supervision Comptable et RH (en binôme)

Encadrer la facturation régulière et en temps utile des clients.
Organiser les relances et suivre le bon recouvrement des factures clients.
Assurer les cycles de paiement (et la collecte systématique des escomptes fournisseurs).
Procéder au contrôle et à la validation finale des factures d'achat du département administratif.
Superviser l'administration RH : contrôler avec ses équipes les temps de travail avant l'envoi en paie, apporter un support à la rédaction de courriers/contrats RH, et faire l'interface avec le comité d'entreprise.
Fixer les grilles salariales annuelles, notamment pour la facturation des heures de projets.

4. Administration des Systèmes, Gérance Juridique, Services Généraux et Projets Transversaux

Gérer l'administration du système ERP (LABEL) : gérer les accès et les droits, effectuer les clôtures mensuelles et annuelles.
Assurer le suivi des engagements contractuels et la gestion globale des assurances (incluant le traitement des sinistres sur les chantiers et les bâtiments).
Assurer la supervision hiérarchique et le contrôle de la gestion du parc automobile (fleet management).
Piloter la qualité (norme ISO 9001) et mener des projets transversaux d'amélioration continue tels que la poursuite de la digitalisation de l'entreprise.


Profil et Qualités Requises:


Compétences Linguistiques:

En raison de la forte multiculturalité de notre entreprise et des interactions quotidiennes avec les différentes équipes, le profil recherché doit impérativement parler et comprendre l'allemand et le français.
La compréhension du luxembourgeois constitue un atout supplémentaire.


Expertise Technique (Hard Skills):

Solide formation et expérience avérée en gestion financière, contrôle de gestion (idéalement appliqué à la gestion de projets) et comptabilité.
Maîtrise des mécanismes de préparation et de justification lors d'audits financiers (ex. : relation avec des auditeurs).
Expérience dans l'administration des Ressources Humaines et le droit contractuel/gestion des assurances.
Forte aisance informatique avec les systèmes de type ERP (l'administration de logiciels type LABEL est un plus).


Savoir-être et Aptitudes (Soft Skills):

Excellente capacité managériale pour encadrer, coordonner et faire évoluer une équipe variée.
Esprit critique et excellente capacité d'analyse pour évaluer et challenger des données financières et économiques.
Sens aigu de l'organisation garantissant une stricte séparation des rôles entre l'exécution, le contrôle et la validation.
Excellentes compétences de communication inter-départements (capacité à lier les visions comptables, administratives et métier).
