title: Postdoctoral Fellows in Educational Measurement
description:
Job description

Applications are invited for 1-2 full time positions for three- to four-years as Postdoctoral Fellows at the Centre for Research on Equality in Education (CREATE), Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo, Norway. The positions have a double affiliation with the Centre for Educational Measurement (CEMO).

CREATE is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway with the objective to generate novel knowledge about how to reduce inequalities in education. The interdisciplinary center integrates researchers with substantive expertise from education, psychology, sociology, economics, and genetics, and methodological expertise from educational measurement, psychometrics, econometrics, statistics, and biostatistics. The Postdoctoral Fellowships are affiliated with CREATE’s research strand 3 «Addressing key methodological challenges».  

CEMO provides a stimulating research environment by bringing internationally renowned substantive and methodological experts together. Research at CEMO combines basic research and applications of advanced measurement techniques to solve core educational problems. CEMO also contributes to the development of measurement competence through teaching and outreach.


More about the positions

The positions are tied to strand 3 of CREATE, which aims to develop novel methods and statistical software that are tailor-made to the research questions and data of CREATE. 

The successful candidate will conduct advanced methodological and psychometric research. Potential research areas include (a) instructional sensitivity and opportunity to learn in international large-scale assessments in education, (b) estimation and inference methods for weighted generalized structural equation models with mixed continuous and discrete data in longitudinal settings, and (c) advancing research synthesis and meta-analytic methods, for instance, to investigate digital inequalities in education using international large-scale assessment data.

The appointments are full-time positions and made for a period of three years, 10% of which is devoted to required duties, usually in the form of teaching activities. If there is a good match between the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs at CEMO, the positions may be extended to four years, 25% of which is devoted to required duties, usually in the form of teaching activities and supervision. For these positions, the teaching activities will be part of CEMO’s master’s programme in Assessment, Measurement and Evaluation.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in one of the social and behavioral sciences, statistics, or computer science applying and/or developing advanced quantitative methods. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Demonstrated fit to one of the three research areas (a) to (c) listed above
  • Proficiency in programming and data analysis in the statistical software environment R, Python, or other relevant programming languages, as evidenced in relevant courses or publication(s)

Applicants will be evaluated as a function of the fit between their qualifications and the research area they apply for. The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • For research area (a), prior experience with IRT/mixed-effects logistic regression and international large-scale assessments in education
  • For research area (b), prior experience with latent variable models and Monte Carlo simulation studies
  • For research area (c), prior experience with meta-analysis/research synthesis and international large-scale assessment data

Personal skills
  • Creativity and ability to work independently 
  • Self-motivated, eager to learn and ready to tackle and deal with challenges
  • Able to collaborate with others 

Personal suitability and motivation for the position will be emphasized.


We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Salary NOK 595 000 - 670 000 per annum depending on qualifications in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352). From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A professionally stimulating work environment
  • An interdisciplinary and international work environment, recognized as a Centre of Excellence
  • Attractive welfare benefits 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (maximum two pages), including a statement of motivation and your fit with one of the research areas (a) to (c) listed above 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor's letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received
  • Copy of the PhD thesis 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • A complete list of publications
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University's grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed. 

In assessing the applicants, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, as well as the candidates motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project in the course of the period of employment.


Formal regulations

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral Fellowships at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellow period at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

CREATE (Centre of Research on Equality in Education) is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway and the Faculty of Educational Sciences. CREATE’s objective is to generate novel knowledge about how to reduce inequalities in education.

title: Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown
description:
Business Controller – bli med og bygg økonomifunksjonen i Podtown

Vil du jobbe tett på ledelsen, internasjonale prosjekter og beslutningene som faktisk betyr noe?

Podtown er i sterk utvikling og bygger nå organisasjonen for neste fase. Vi utvikler og leverer modulære rom- og infrastrukturløsninger til krevende markeder som forsvar og beredskap. Nå søker vi en Business Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i selskapet – tett på ledelsen, prosjektene og den operative virksomheten.

Dette er ikke en tradisjonell controllerrolle hvor hovedoppgaven er å rapportere på det som allerede har skjedd. Vi ser etter deg som vil forstå hva som skjer i virksomheten, se fremover og bidra til bedre beslutninger.

Regnskapet håndteres i stor grad eksternt. Din viktigste jobb blir derfor å sørge for at Podtown har kontroll på prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser, marginer og økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag. Rollen skal være Podtowns interne økonomiske kontrollpunkt og en viktig sparringspartner for ledelsen.

En rolle med reell påvirkning

Podtown har en liten og kompetent organisasjon og arbeider med komplekse leveranser mot internasjonale kunder. Selskapet har etablert seg i forsvarsmarkedet og står foran en fase hvor både prosjektene og organisasjonen skal skaleres.

Som Business Controller får du en bred rolle. Du vil blant annet:

  • etablere og følge opp prosjektbudsjetter, faktiske kostnader, committed cost, forecast, inntekter og marginer

  • bygge og følge opp rullerende likviditets- og cash flow-prognoser

  • analysere avvik og bidra til at tiltak blir satt inn tidlig

  • etablere en enkel og robust struktur for månedsrapportering, periodiseringer og avsetninger

  • arbeide tett med prosjektansvarlige, leverandører og produksjonspartnere for å forstå kostnadsdrivere, kapasitet og risiko

  • utarbeide økonomiske beslutningsgrunnlag og rapportering til CEO, styre og eiere

  • støtte selskapet i dialog med bank, revisor, regnskapsfører og øvrige rådgivere

  • bidra i finansierings-, garanti-, forsikrings- og kapitalprosesser

  • bygge Podtowns egne økonomiske arbeidsprosesser og systemer etter hvert som virksomheten vokser.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du har noen års erfaring fra controlling, prosjektøkonomi eller økonomistyring og nå ønsker deg nærmere både virksomheten og beslutningene.

Du kan for eksempel arbeide som Business Controller, Project Controller, prosjektøkonom eller Financial Controller i dag. Erfaring fra prosjektbasert virksomhet, industri, maritim sektor, energi eller tilsvarende vil være relevant, men er ikke et absolutt krav.

Vi ser særlig etter deg som har:

  • høyere utdanning innen økonomi, finans eller regnskap

  • gjerne rundt 3–7 års relevant erfaring

  • god forståelse for regnskap og økonomiske sammenhenger

  • interesse for prosjektøkonomi, likviditet, prognoser og business partnering

  • gode ferdigheter i Excel og god systemforståelse

  • evne til å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger forståelige og beslutningsrelevante.

Like viktig er hvordan du jobber.

Du trives i et miljø med tempo, korte beslutningsveier og tydelige forventninger. Du er selvstendig nok til å drive egne områder fremover, men samtidig trygg nok til å diskutere, utfordre og sparre med ledelsen når tallene tilsier det.

Du trenger ikke være den som alltid har det mest kompliserte regnearket. Viktigere er det at du forstår hva tallene betyr, ser hva som krever handling og klarer å gjøre økonomiske problemstillinger konkrete og beslutningsrelevante.

Vi tror du vil lykkes godt i rollen dersom du:

  • tar eierskap og følger opp til ting faktisk er ferdige

  • arbeider strukturert og trives med ansvar

  • er analytisk, men også pragmatisk og løsningsorientert

  • kommuniserer tydelig på både norsk og engelsk, og tør å stå for egne faglige vurderinger

    bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt på tvers

  • trives med frihet innen tydelige rammer

Hvorfor Podtown?

Dette er en sjelden mulighet til å komme inn på et tidspunkt hvor du faktisk kan være med og forme hvordan økonomifunksjonen skal fungere.

Du får:

  • stor påvirkning og kort vei fra analyse til beslutning

  • tett samarbeid med CEO, COO og selskapets ledelse

  • ansvar for økonomien i komplekse og internasjonale prosjekter

  • innsikt i et spennende marked med krevende kunder og leveranser

  • mulighet til å bygge systemer, arbeidsprosesser og rapportering – ikke bare overta dem

  • en rolle som kan utvikle seg mot et bredere økonomiansvar etter hvert som Podtown vokser.

Du vil få betydelig ansvar og handlingsrom, samtidig som det forventes fremdrift, kvalitet og selvstendighet i rollen.

Podtown passer særlig godt for deg som ønsker mer ansvar og større påvirkning enn du typisk får som én av mange controllere i et større konsern.

Arbeidssted

Grieg Gaarden, Bergen
Stillingen er 100 % og rapporterer til CEO.

title: Dette er ikkje ei tradisjonell stilling innan eitt fagområde!
description:
Osland-konsernet er et av landets eldste akvakulturselskaper med hovedkontor i Bjordal, Høyanger. Konsernet driver en helhetlig verdikjede innen produksjon av ørret – fra genetikk og settefisk til matfiskproduksjon.

 

Vi søkjer ein strukturert og allsidig medarbeider som skal arbeide på tvers av konsernet.

 

Dette er ei brei og operativ rolle. Du vil støtte fleire fagområde og bidra til at oppgåver blir følgde opp på ein god og systematisk måte. Du vil jobbe med digitalisering og forenkling. Du motiveres av å skape struktur, sikre kvalitet og finne smartere og mer effektive måter å arbeide på.

 

Rolla passar for deg som likar variasjon. Du må trivast med å arbeide med både detaljar og større problemstillingar. Du vil få bred innsikt i selskapets verksemd og være bidragsyter for felles leveranser i konsernet.

 

Arbeidsoppgåver

 

Du vil få oppgåver innan fleire delar av verksemda, både innen verksemdsstyring og prosjekt. Innhaldet vil utvikle seg over tid.

 

Aktuelle arbeidsoppgåver vil vere:

  • Planlegging og gjennomføring av administrasjonsoppgaver
  • Ansvar for vedlikehold og arbeid i kvalitetssystem og interne rutinar etter årshjul
  • Forenkle og effektivisere administrative arbeidsprosesser, blant annet med bruk av KI.
  • Følge opp at lover, krav og interne retningslinjer blir etterlevd
  • Arbeid med rapportering fra prosjekt og støtte til prosjektorganisasjon i utviklingarbeid
  • Planlegge og drive mindre prosjekt, utviklingstiltak og forbedringsarbeid.
  • Støtte og oppfølging i revisjoner, kontroller og avvik.
  • Arbeid i system med arkivering, og oversikt over avtalar og dokumentasjon
  • Arbeid i informasjonskanalar og aktiv kommunikasjon
  • Administrativ støtte innan strukturelle system, utvikling og effektivisering
  • Innhente, strukturere dokumentasjon og styringsinformasjon på tvers av konsernet
  • Støtte økonomiarbeid med rapportering, dokumentasjon og oppfølging
  • Deltaking i prosjekt og forbetringsarbeid

 

Kven ser vi etter?

 

Vi ser etter ein person som er strukturert og nøyaktig. Du må like å få oversikt og sørgje for framdrift. Du har evne til å gripe om deg og er uredd i tilnærming til et større omfang.

 

Du arbeider sjølvstendig og er datakyndig. Samstundes må du kunne samarbeide godt med ulike delar av organisasjonen.

 

Vi ser gjerne at du har utdanning eller erfaring innan eitt eller fleire av desse områda:

 

  • Økonomi og administrasjon
  • Kvalitet eller HMS, juridiske/organisatoriske fag
  • Havbruksledelse

Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

 

Det viktigaste er at du har god forretningsforståing. Du må også vere komfortabel med å setje deg inn i nye fagområde og kunne sjå heilheten av kontinuerlig forbedring. Du er god i microsoft verktøy og spesielt Office 365.

 

Vi trur du vil lykkast dersom du

  • Arbeider systematisk og tek ansvar
  • Har høg gjennomføringsevne
  • Er god til å halde oversikt
  • Kommuniserer klart og presist
  • Behandlar konfidensiell informasjon på ein trygg måte
  • Likar å finne praktiske løysingar

 

Ei rolle med stor breidde

 

Dette er ikkje ei tradisjonell stilling innan eitt fagområde.

 

Du vil arbeide i skjeringspunktet mellom kvalitet, etterleving og administrasjon. Du vil også støtte arbeid innan økonomi, HR, KHMS og juridiske saker. Vi er spesielt interessert dersom du har arbeid i skjeringspunktet mellom produksjon, økonomi og andre datautrekk.

 

Rolla gir derfor stor innsikt i korleis konsernet blir drive.

 

For den rette personen vil det vere gode moglegheiter til å utvikle både rolla og ansvarsområdet.

 

Vi tilbyr

 

  • Gode muligheter til å påvirke og videreutvikle konsernets prosesser og digitale løsninger.
  • Moderne systemer og digitale verktøy, samt gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og videreutdanning.
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og et stabilt og utviklende arbeidsmiljø ved vårt avdelingskontor i Sandviken, Bergen.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte vår rekrutteringsrådgiver i Lederhuset AS, Bjarne Jacobsen.

title: Assistant Kitchen Manager – EGON Brygga, Tromsø
description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your kitchen career and be part of opening a brand-new EGON restaurant?

 

EGON is one of Norway’s strongest and most successful restaurant concepts. We are now looking for a motivated and ambitious Assistant Kitchen Manager to join the leadership team at the new EGON Brygga in Tromsø.

 

Located directly on the waterfront in the heart of Tromsø, EGON Brygga will be a large new restaurant with approximately 300 seats. This is an exciting opportunity to join from the beginning, help build a strong kitchen team and contribute to establishing the standards, culture and daily operations of a brand-new restaurant.

About the Role

As Assistant Kitchen Manager, you will be the Kitchen Manager’s right hand and an important part of the restaurant’s leadership team. You will work closely with the Kitchen Manager and General Manager and take active responsibility for daily kitchen operations, quality, structure and team development.

 

The position combines hands-on kitchen work with leadership, planning and follow-up. You will also play an important role in creating a strong team and ensuring that EGON’s routines and standards are implemented from day one. For the right candidate, this can also be an excellent step toward becoming a Kitchen Manager within EGON in the future.

Main Responsibilities
  • Support the Kitchen Manager in the daily operation of the kitchen
  • Take responsibility for kitchen operations when the Kitchen Manager is absent
  • Ensure consistently high food quality and presentation
  • Participate actively in food preparation and à la carte service
  • Follow up routines related to HACCP / food safety and hygiene
  • Help train, motivate and develop kitchen employees
  • Contribute to efficient staffing, planning and organization
  • Follow EGON’s routines, systems and operational standards
  • Help create a positive, structured and professional working environment
  • Contribute to building a strong kitchen team at the new restaurant
Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who enjoys responsibility and thrives in a busy restaurant environment.

 

You preferably have:

  • Relevant experience from a professional kitchen
  • Experience from high-volume restaurants or similar operations
  • Previous leadership experience, or a strong motivation to develop into a leadership role
  • Good organizational and communication skills
  • A hands-on approach and willingness to lead by example
  • The ability to remain structured and focused during busy services
  • A positive attitude and strong work ethic
  • A genuine interest in food, people and restaurant operations
  • Good communication skills in English. Speaking Norwegian is a big plus.

Experience as a Sous Chef, Assistant Kitchen Manager, Shift Leader, Team Leader or similar is an advantage.

What We Offer

At EGON Brygga, you will have the opportunity to join a completely new restaurant from the beginning and become part of building the team and operation. EGON offers a structured working environment with established systems, training and opportunities for professional development. As part of a large and growing restaurant group, there are also good opportunities for further career development for employees who want more responsibility.

 

You will become part of an ambitious leadership team in one of Tromsø’s most exciting new restaurant openings.

If you are an experienced kitchen professional who wants more responsibility and the opportunity to develop as a leader, we would like to hear from you.

 

Apply today and become part of the team opening EGON Brygga in Tromsø!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

EGON Brygga will be a brand-new EGON restaurant opening at the historic Bangsundbrygga, directly on the waterfront in central Tromsø. The restaurant will have around 300 seats, including both indoor and outdoor seating. With its spectacular waterfront location and views of Tromsø’s surrounding mountains, EGON Brygga aims to become a natural meeting place for locals and visitors alike. The restaurant will offer EGON’s broad à la carte menu in a warm and informal atmosphere, while the design will preserve the historic character and architecture of Bangsundbrygga.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics
description:
About the position

Integreat - the Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at the University of Oslo invites applications for a doctoral research fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics. We seek a motivated researcher, who values collaboration, inclusivity, and impact, and who would like to contribute to a supportive, interdisciplinary research environment with strong focus on mentoring and career development.

Starting date upon individual agreement and preferably no later than 1st of April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at University of Oslo at Blindern, Oslo.

We welcome applicants with a strong background in machine learning and statistics, who are eager to contribute to cutting-edge methods for generating private and fair synthetic data with good utility. This project involves development of deep learning based synthetic data generators that obtain both good utility and protection of privacy, through tailored model approximation, as well as new measures of privacy and fairness to be used for assessing properties of synthetic generators, or in loss functions for training them. Further, the potentials and limitations of the developed approaches should be critically assessed regarding their implications for fairness, privacy, and utility. This project is at the intersection of machine learning, statistics and ethics.

This position is affiliated with the research group research group in Statistics and Data Science at the Department of Mathematics at University of Oslo, in close collaboration with the machine learning group at the Department of Informatics.


About Integreat

See the video for more information about Integreat.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-_I52cJHiW4About Integreat 

Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research Council of Norway. Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway). This position is in Oslo.

Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore it is a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world. Integreat develops theories, methods, models, and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. We do this by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technology, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

The focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and therefore solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Qualification requirements:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, statistics, data science, mathematics, or related field
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Employment and admission to the PhD programme are conditional upon successful completion of the Master's degree and submission of official documentation confirming that the degree has been awarded. Applicants who are in the final stages of completing their Master's degree may still apply.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with deep learning models
  • Strong background in programming
  • A keen interest in considering and discussing ethical aspects of the research projects
  • Experience with interdisciplinary work

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements: 

The norm is as follows:

  • the average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see: Supplementary Regulations at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences to the Regulations for the Degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo - The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


Personal skills

We are looking for candidates who are curious, open-minded, and motivated to learn. You should enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, and be comfortable communicating your ideas clearly across disciplines. A collaborative spirit, a strong sense of responsibility, and a willingness to contribute to an inclusive and respectful research culture are essential.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

Integreat is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and belonging, guided by our INTEGREAT principles (Integrity, Non discrimination, Tact, Environment, Gratitude, Respect, Empathy, Accountability, Transparency). We embed these values in practice through inclusive hiring and structured evaluations, targeted mentoring and career development, and flexible work arrangements and accommodations to ensure everyone can thrive and contribute.

We particularly welcome applications from women and gender minorities who are underrepresented in STEM, as well as applicants with immigrant backgrounds, disabilities, non linear career paths, or career breaks. We will take career interruptions and diverse career trajectories into account during evaluation.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

title: Senior Purchaser
description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Through strong engineering expertise, cutting-edge technology, and close collaboration, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment where talent can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make a difference.

VARD Electro is a leading supplier of maritime electrical systems, automation, integration, and energy solutions for vessels operating worldwide. With a strong focus on innovation, digitalization, and sustainability, we develop advanced technologies that help our customers improve efficiency, safety, and environmental performance. As part of the VARD Group, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to shape the future of the maritime industry.

We are currently looking for a Senior Purchaser, to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Manage purchasing activities within the navigation equipment area, including DP systems, sensors, positioning and related navigation and bridge equipment.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers.
  • Lead supplier negotiations on price, delivery, commercial terms and contracts.
  • Develop and re-negotiate framework agreements, price lists and other commercial agreements.
  • Evaluate supplier offers and perform commercial analysis.
  • Ensure competitive pricing and support cost reduction and procurement improvement initiatives.
  • Work closely with Engineering and other stakeholders to ensure technical and commercial alignment.
  • Follow up supplier performance, deliveries and commercial topics.
  • Analyze purchasing and spend data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure correct procurement data, pricing and supplier information are maintained in SAP/ERP.
  • Support continuous improvement of procurement processes and ways of working. 
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education within procurement, supply chain, business, engineering or a related field.
  • Several years of relevant procurement experience, preferably within marine, maritime, offshore or industrial equipment.
  • Competence and experience within navigation equipment, ideally including DP systems, sensors, positioning and related systems is preferred.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills.
  • Good analytical skills.
  • Experience with contracts, supplier management and commercial agreements.
  • Good understanding of technical products and the ability to work effectively with Engineering and other technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Commercially minded and results oriented.
  • Structured and analytical.
  • Independent and proactive.
  • A strong communicator and negotiator.
  • Comfortable working across different functions and with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Able to take ownership and drive activities to completion. 
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with Social by VARD you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

title: Er du god med mennesker og liker å finne de beste løsningene for kunden?
description:
Toyota Haugesund søker kunderådgiver

Du trenger ikke å kunne alt om bil for å lykkes som kunderådgiver hos Toyota Haugesund. Det viktigste er at du liker mennesker, trives med ansvar og motiveres av å skape gode kundeopplevelser.

Som kunderådgiver blir du bindeleddet mellom kundene våre og verkstedet. Du følger kunden gjennom hele besøket, fra bilen leveres inn til nøklene gis tilbake, og sørger for god kommunikasjon og en trygg opplevelse underveis.

Du får en variert arbeidshverdag hvor kundekontakt kombineres med koordinering, salg og administrative oppgaver. Noen dager handler det om å finne den beste løsningen for en kunde, andre ganger om å sørge for at deler er på plass, følge opp en verkstedordre eller sikre at kunden vet hva som skjer med bilen.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Ta imot kunder ved innlevering og utlevering av bil
  • Veilede og følge opp kunder gjennom verkstedbesøket
  • Identifisere behov og tilby relevante verkstedtjenester
  • Følge opp deler og bestillinger
  • Håndtere ordre og fakturering
  • Sørge for god kommunikasjon mellom kunde og verksted
  • Bidra til at kundene våre får en best mulig opplevelse
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som naturlig setter kunden først. Du er god til å lytte, forstå behov og finne løsninger, samtidig som du klarer å holde oversikt når det er mye som skjer.

Du trives med mennesker og kommuniserer godt med ulike typer kunder. Samtidig har du interesse for bil og en teknisk forståelse som gjør at du raskt kan sette deg inn i kundens behov og problemstillinger.

Erfaring fra bilbransjen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du jobbet med kundeservice, rådgivning eller salg og kjenner deg igjen i rollen, ønsker vi også å høre fra deg.

Vi tror du:

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner og liker kundekontakt
  • Har interesse for bil og god teknisk forståelse
  • Er serviceinnstilt og opptatt av gode kundeopplevelser
  • Er strukturert og løsningsorientert
  • Har god arbeidskapasitet og tar ansvar
  • Er komfortabel med IT som arbeidsverktøy
  • Trives med både selvstendig arbeid og samarbeid
Hvorfor Toyota Haugesund?

Hos Toyota Haugesund blir du en del av en komplett bilforhandler hvor salg, verksted, karosseri, lakkering, klargjøring, deler og dekk er samlet under samme tak.

Du får jobbe med en av verdens mest kjente bilmerkevarer og blir en del av et fagmiljø hvor kvalitet, kontinuerlig forbedring og gode kundeopplevelser står sentralt.

Hos oss får du blant annet:

  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Opplæring og faglig utvikling gjennom Toyotas opplæringsprogrammer
  • God støtte fra dyktige kollegaer
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste og tilgang til personalhytte
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på gode arbeidsforhold
  • Muligheten til å utvikle deg i en solid virksomhet og en bilbransje i stor utvikling
Om Toyota Haugesund

Toyota Haugesund er en del av Jæger Automobil AS og er en komplett bilforhandler på Haugalandet. Fra anlegget i Salhusvegen tilbyr vi blant annet nye og brukte biler, verkstedtjenester, deler og tilbehør, dekkhotell, karosseri, lakkering og klargjøring.

Jæger Automobil er en del av Jægergruppen, Vestlandets største bilforhandler, og representerer Toyota, Lexus, BMW og MINI. Konsernet har over 250 ansatte og en årlig omsetning på 1,6 milliarder kroner.

Klar for å bli Toyota Haugesund sitt nye ansikt ut mot verkstedkundene?

title: Sales development
description:
We are looking for a motivated full-time sales professional to join our commercial team. In this role, you will work with the CamReach platform, run outbound campaigns, follow up with prospects by phone, and support the development of our commercial pipeline.

This is a hands-on B2B sales role with a strong focus on outbound calling, but you will not be working alone. You will have a support structure around you with pre-sales research, target selection, prospect data, campaign messaging, and the CamReach platform helping you prepare for and follow up each conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make outbound cold calls to selected Nordic SMB prospects based on structured pre-sales research and qualification

  • Follow up on prospects already engaged through CamReach campaigns across email and LinkedIn

  • Work from prepared target lists, company research, contact data, campaign messaging, and call support provided by the wider sales operation

  • Use the CamReach platform to understand prospect activity, engagement, and relevant context before and after calls

  • Qualify interest, identify sales opportunities, and move relevant prospects into the next stage of the sales process

  • Maintain accurate CRM and campaign records, including call outcomes, follow-up actions, and prospect feedback

  • Work closely with the sales team to continuously improve targeting, messaging, call scripts, and campaign performance

Mindset & Work Style

  • Self-managed and target-driven, and comfortable taking responsibility for your own activity and results

  • Comfortable working in an early-stage company where processes continue to evolve

  • Confident speaking with new prospects and starting commercial conversations

  • Professional and comfortable using LinkedIn as part of the sales process

  • Commercially minded and interested in understanding how different businesses sell and acquire customers

  • Willing to learn, test different approaches, and use feedback to improve

Skills

  • Fluency in Norwegian or one of the Scandinavian languages is a must

  • Strong verbal communication skills and confidence on the phone

  • Ability to independently research, understand, and qualify prospects

  • Ability to communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different companies and decision-makers

  • Comfortable using CRM systems, sales platforms, and digital tools

  • Confident handling objections and progressing conversations towards a meeting or next step

Experience

  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, or a similar commercial role

  • Experience with outbound calling and prospecting

  • Experience with cold outreach across channels such as phone, email, and LinkedIn

  • A track record of working towards activity, pipeline, or sales targets


Perks and benefits

  • Full-time position

  • Flexible working hours

  • Remote work allowed

  • Office location near public transport

  • Opportunity to grow with an early-stage technology company and take on increasing responsibility as the team expands

Working at CamReach AS

CamReach is a B2B sales platform built around three core capabilities: Discover. Qualify. Engage.

The platform helps companies identify the right prospects, qualify which opportunities are worth pursuing, and engage them through coordinated outreach across channels such as email and LinkedIn. The aim is to give sales teams a more structured and effective way to build pipeline, with better data, better preparation, and more relevant outreach.

CamReach comes from a strong software development and technology background. The platform has been developed by a team of experienced developers, data analysts, and data scientists with deep experience in building digital products, data-driven systems, and business applications.

The wider team combines this technical capability with senior commercial and executive experience across technology, international business development, sales, and company building. This means we approach the product from both sides: how the technology should work, and how it needs to perform in a real commercial environment.

We are an early-stage Norwegian technology company with paying customers and an active commercial pipeline. We also have an ambitious product and growth roadmap ahead of us, with plans to expand both the capabilities of the platform and the markets we serve.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at an early stage, grow with the team, take on increasing responsibility, and be part of building the commercial side of a technology company with significant ambitions for the years ahead.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

CamReach is a B2B outbound sales platform built for Nordic and European SMBs. We help sales teams find the right prospects, run multichannel outreach across email and LinkedIn, and book more meetings, without adding headcount or relying on expensive agencies. The platform is built around a simple idea: precision beats volume. Instead of blasting thousands of generic messages, CamReach helps companies identify the right targets, craft relevant outreach, and learn from every campaign to get sharper over time. We are an early-stage Norwegian startup with paying customers, an active pipeline, and a team that moves fast. GDPR compliance is built into the core of what we do, which matters increasingly for companies selling into European markets. We are now expanding our go-to-market engine and looking for driven people to join the team.

title: PhD position in cancer chromatin biology
description:
About the position

Applications are invited to apply for a 100% 3-year PhD position in cancer chromatin and structural biology in the research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, project group of Dr. Marie Rogne, at the Department of Molecular Medicine, Division of Biochemistry, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is funded through the Norwegian Research Council. The successful candidate will collaborate with partners at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU).

Within the Institute, the Division of Biochemistry consists of a young and active community of nine research groups working on cancer biology, chromatin and nuclear dynamics, nuclear architecture, membrane trafficking, and adipocyte, muscle and vascular biology, using human, fly and mouse models. 


More about the position

The overall goal of the project is to establish knowledge of the innovative therapeutic potential of microproteins in advanced prostate cancer. In this context, the successful applicant will, in collaboration with the rest of the team and external partners, examine how specific microproteins regulate the activity of the transcription factor SOX2 using cell-based and epigenomic assays, and resolve the SOX2 microprotein complex using a crystallographic approach.

To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow, admission to the Medical Faculty's PhD program is required, or there must be a binding agreement for admission. Normally, one must apply for admission within 3 months after the start of the research project leading to the Ph.D. degree. The PhD fellow is expected to complete the project within three years.


Responsibilities
  • Plan and execute experiments in genomics (RNA‑seq/ATAC‑seq/ChIP‑seq), proteomics and recombinant protein expression/purification.
  • Design and perform cellular assays.
  • Maintain accurate electronic lab records, analyze and interpret data.
  • Present results at group meetings and scientific platforms, and contribute to manuscript writing.
  • Take the required doctoral coursework.

Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • To be admitted to the PhD programmes at the University of Oslo, an applicant must have a five year master's degree or equivalent studies in molecular biology, epigenetics or a related field, minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent.
  • Experience in cell and molecular biology, including vector design, cloning, engineering cell lines, cell-based assays
  • Knowledge and experience in chromatin, transcriptional regulation or microproteins.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications

  • Experience in proteomics (wet-lab and data analysis) will be a strong advantage. 
  • Some background in bioinformatics analysis of epigenetic data (RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, etc) is a plus.
  • Experience with electronic lab-journal systems (e.g. Benchling or E-lab) is valued.
  • Previous publishing experience is positive. 

Personal skills
  • You are independent but enjoy working as part of a team towards shared, ambitious goals.
  • You are positive, structured, solution-driven and accurate, with grit and determination.
  • You have a result-oriented mindset and contribute scientific and practical inputs to projects.
  • You are eager to learn and develop your scientific thinking.
  • Communication with other team members is important: you will therefore have excellent communication and collaborative skills. 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

If we cannot, you will hear from us.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

 

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

title: Researcher in mathematical modelling of hub molecules
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

A temporary position as Researcher in mathematical modelling of hub molecules is available within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie (MSCA-DN) network HubMOL. The position is for a period of two years and three months. It will be affiliated with the Bioinformatics and Systems Biology Group at The Department of Arctic and Marine Biology at UiT. The candidate will be enrolled in the Ph.D. program at the faculty. The research project will be on mathematical modelling approaches targeting mitochondrial metabolism of hub molecules with focus on metabolic flux analysis.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. 


The position's field of Research

The main task of the project will be the reconstruction of models of mitochondrial biochemistry with strong focus on transport and dynamics of hub molecules and related post translational modifications and the development of new approaches for metabolic flux analyses to unravel the impact of changes in hub molecules on protein modification dynamics. 


Qualifications

Marie Skłodowska-Curie (MSCA-DN) education program enrollment requirements:

  • The candidate must not have completed a PhD. 
  • The candidate must not have lived, studied or worked for more than12 months in Norway within the last 36 months. 
  • The candidate should describe his/her motivation to join the project and how his/her prior experience will help to develop the project.
  • The position requires to spend several month in other research institutions within the network. 

Required qualifications: 

  • Successfully completed a master in biochemistry, biophysics, or mathematical biology or similar qualification.
  • Strong background in mathematics as well as programming experience in Python.
  • Good understanding of biochemistry.
  • Documented good written and oral  proficiency in English language.
  • We are looking for a colleague with excellent cooperation skills, and a positive attitude towards collaborative research, education and outreach. The successful candidate must have ambitions for a Ph.D. and be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

Additional desirable qualifications, knowledge and experience: 

  • experience in the use of advanced AI models
  • working experience in mathematical modelling of biological pathways beyond the master, especially metabolic flux analysis - 
  • experience in the interpretation of metabolomics mass spectrometry data

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Application

The applicants may be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants'
qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position. The application must include the following:

  • Cover letter including a description of interests, motivation and reasons for applying for the position.
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work. 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all relevant degrees, in original language and translated). 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable.
  • Two references with contact details. 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important.
  • Documentation of English proficiency. Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 
    • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
    • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
    • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
    • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
    • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 
    • Or, by using alternatives listed here.

All of the documentation in the application has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no. The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations.


We offer
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good career opportunities
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund

The remuneration for Researcher is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1108, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 540.000,- to 590.000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases a higher salary might be considered. As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes availiable. For more information see: spk.no.

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics. The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

title: Automasjonsingeniør
description:
Om stillingen

På grunn av økende oppdragsmengde, er vi på jakt etter deg som har erfaring med design av elektriske systemer, styresystemer og programmering/igangkjøring av styresystemer (PLS).

De fleste arbeidsoppgaver utfører vi fra kontorsted. Nordkontakt har kunder over hele landet, så noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk, igangkjøring nye anlegg og serviceoppdrag må påregnes.

Vi har kontorsted i Bodø, men kan også vurdere andre lokasjoner om rette søker dukker opp.

Automasjonsavdelingen vår har i dag 40 ansatte, med en god bredde med tanke på bakgrunn og grunnutdanning. Her kan nevnes ingeniørutdanning/bachelor og master innen automasjon/cybernetikk, elkraft, mekatronikk og datateknikk. I tillegg har flere fagbrev som automatiker, elektriker, maskinist, kjølemontør og lignende som basis før høyere utdanning. En herlig blanding som gjør at vi sammen finner gode løsninger i et bredt spekter av oppdrag. Nordkontakt har som mål å være blant de fremste i bransjen på å teste ut og utvikle nye tekniske løsninger.


Som ingeniør i Nordkontakt

 Får du :

  • Jobbe med spennende kunder
  • Utvikle deg faglig i et sterkt teknisk miljø
  • Være med å teste ut nye systemer og tekniske løsninger
  • Ta et tydelig teknisk ansvar i prosjekter
  • Et spennende fagmiljø innen moderne og avanserte automasjonssystemer
  • Bred teknisk eksponering fra design til ferdig anlegg
  • Et kompetent og uformelt fagmiljø
  • Reell påvirkningsmulighet
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig
  • Korte beslutningsveier og høy grad av tillit

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Prosjektering automasjonsanlegg.

• Programmering styresystemer og sikkerhetssystemer

• Konfigurering/programmering/design HMI og driftskontrollanlegg. Alarmhåndtering, datalogg og rapportering. 

• FAT- og SAT-prosesser - igangsetting nye anlegg

• Dokumentasjon 

• Serviceprosjekter - feilsøking, vedlikehold og ombygging eksisterende anlegg

• Oppsett servere/nettverksutstyr for automasjonsanlegg og driftskontroll

Avhengig av din kunnskap og erfaring, kan det også være aktuelt med arbeidsoppgaver/støttefunksjon opp mot andre funksjoner og fagfelt i bedriften. Våre leveransen stiller store krav til både IT- og OT sikkerhet.


Kvalifikasjoner

Vi søker deg som har :

Bachelor eller Master innen automasjon, kybernetikk, elektro eller tilsvarende. 

Du kan også ha teknisk fagskole innen elektro/automasjon.

Kan vise til arbeidserfaring fra lignende type arbeid.


Vi ser etter deg som
  • Er systematisk og strukturert.
  • Har lyst å jobbe direkte mot kunder.
  • Er faglig trygg og kunne jobbe selvstendig under tidspress.
  • Har god skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne.
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk skriftlig/muntlig.
  • Har mulighet for noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk og igangkjøring av anlegg.
  • Har arbeidserfaring med lignende type arbeid.

Gode grunner til å jobbe i Nordkontakt

Gode grunner til å jobbe hos oss

Vi kan tilby en spennende stilling med utfordrende arbeid i en bedrift i vekst. Foruten et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og en stor dose godt humør kan vi også tilby:

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med god spredning i alder og kompetanse
  • Stor påvirkningskraft over din egen arbeidshverdag
  • Å delta på våre gøye sosiale tiltak
  • Treningsavtaler
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • En attraktiv bonusavtale

Vår viktigste kapital er våre medarbeidere! Vi setter derfor utvikling og kompetanseheving hos våre ansatte veldig høyt. Det forvalter vi som best vi kan i opplæringsplattformen vår Elektroakademiet. Les mer om hvordan vi legger til rette for at medarbeiderne våre kan søke ny- eller friske opp sin kunnskap via denne linken.


Vi trenger flere kvinner!

Vi og resten av Elektrogruppen anser mangfold som en styrke, og oppfordrer derfor spesielt kvinner til å søke. Les mer om våre målsettinger og hvordan vi arbeider med å styrke mangfoldet i vår likestillingsredegjørelse.


Vi tar bærekraft på alvor

For oss er bærekraft en del av alt vi gjør. Vi utvikler løsninger som reduserer utslipp og fremmer energieffektivitet, samtidig som vi skaper trygge og gode arbeidsplasser for våre ansatte. Les mer i vår bærekraftsrapport.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordkontakt er en ingeniørbedrift med 105 ansatte som jobber med automasjon, tavleproduksjon, digitalisering, informasjonsteknologi og elektro. Vi har hovedkontor i Bodø, avdelingskontor i Ørsta/Volda og er ledende innfor våre områder med en historikk tilbake til1966.

Vi er i dag en betydelig aktør innenfor automatisering av landbasert settefisk- og oppdrettsanlegg. Vi har også kunder innen slakteri, vei, jernbane, gruvedrift, forskningsfartøy, fiskebåter, bygg, industri, VA-anlegg og energi. Nordkontakt tilbyr også skybaserte tjenester ifm. SD-anlegg (NK-sky) til våre kunder. 

Vi har en stor IT-avdeling som leverer kameraløsninger samt bistår med OT-sikkerheten til våre kunders anlegg. 

Nordkontakt leverer produkter og tjenester på alle nivå i prosessen, fra enkle komponenter til ferdige idriftsatte anlegg. Vi har flere ulike testverksted tilknyttet våre ulike fag. Og om vi ikke har funnet komponenter som dekker kundenes behov, så har vi faktisk bare utviklet disse selv. 

Vårt verdigrunnlag er tuftet på at vi er en bedrift som opptrer Fremtidsrettet Ansvarlig Løsningsorientert og Kompetent. Vi løser våre oppdrag med målsetting om å skape trygghet for våre kunder, så vel som våre medarbeidere og samfunnet vi er en del av, og i Nordkontakt, holder vi det vi lover!

Vi er en del av konsernet Elektrogruppen, en av landets største private tekniske entreprenører med virksomhet fra Trøndelag i sør til Vesterålen i nord.  Samlet er nesten 700 ansatte, fordelt på 15 entreprenører. Effektivt tverrfaglig samarbeid og erfaringsutveksling bedriftene imellom gir positive effekter for våre kunder lokalt.

title: Senior Financial Controller - regnskap og rapportering - Osland AS
description:
Osland-konsernet er et av landets eldste akvakulturselskaper, med virksomhet innen genetikk, settefisk og matfiskproduksjon. Vi søker nå en erfaren Senior Financial Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i videreutviklingen av konsernets økonomifunksjon.

 

Rollen er knyttet til Osland AS-delkonsernet, som består av Osland AS og fem datterselskaper, i tillegg til løpende oppfølging av fire produksjonsregnskap. Dette gir et bredt og komplekst økonomisk landskap med behov for god forståelse av sammenhengen mellom selskapsregnskap, produksjon, rapportering og styringsinformasjon. Dette er en bred seniorrolle for deg som har solid regnskapsforståelse, liker å skape struktur og kvalitet, og samtidig motiveres av utvikling, systemer og smartere arbeidsprosesser.

 

Du vil arbeide tett med økonomisjef/CFO, Business Controller og regnskapsførerne, og få en viktig rolle i å sikre kvalitet i regnskap og rapportering på tvers av selskaper og produksjonsområder.

 

Stillingen spenner fra operative og regnskapsnære oppgaver til rapportering, budsjett, internkontroll, systemutvikling og forbedring av økonomiprosesser. Vi ser derfor etter en erfaren person som trives med bredde og variasjon, og som er komfortabel med at prioriteringene kan variere gjennom året.

Om rollen

Som Senior Financial Controller vil du være en sentral fagressurs i økonomiteamet og bidra til at regnskap, tallgrunnlag og rapportering holder høy kvalitet. Du vil arbeide tett med regnskapsførerne og Business Controller i den månedlige lukkingen av regnskapene, og bidra til gode rutiner, avstemminger, periodiseringer og regnskapsmessige vurderinger. Samtidig vil du ha en viktig rolle innen konsolidering, rapportering, budsjett og prognoser, og være med på å videreutvikle konsernets økonomiske styringsinformasjon.

 

En viktig del av rollen er også løpende arbeid med å styrke internkontroll og strukturkapital. Det innebærer å bidra til tydelige rutiner, dokumenterte arbeidsprosesser, god ansvarsdeling og etterlevelse av etablerte prinsipper og kontrollaktiviteter. Vi arbeider tett med robuste prosesser som er forståelige, etterleves i organisasjonen og er mindre personavhengige.

 

Du vil også bidra til å utvikle måten vi arbeider på gjennom bedre utnyttelse av ERP-system, rapporteringsløsninger, data og automatisering.

 

Rollen passer godt for deg som liker kombinasjonen av regnskap, kvalitet, internkontroll, systemforståelse og utvikling. Dette er en seniorrolle som krever at du arbeider selvstendig, tar eierskap til dine ansvarsområder og selv ser hvor det er behov for oppfølging eller forbedring. Vi ser etter en person som tar initiativ, driver saker fremover og bidrar der behovet er størst.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Delta aktivt i månedlig regnskapsavslutning for selskapene og sikre god kvalitet og fremdrift i closingprosessen
  • Kvalitetssikre regnskap, avstemminger, periodiseringer og vesentlige regnskapsmessige vurderinger
  • Bidra til konsolidering og konsernrapportering
  • Kvalitetssikre og videreutvikle månedlig rapportering og styringsinformasjon
  • Ha en sentral rolle i omfattende budsjett- og prognoseprosesser
  • Følge opp balanse, arbeidskapital, kontantstrøm og grunnlag for likviditetsprognoser
  • Følge opp internprising, internfakturering og konserninterne avregninger
  • Arbeide med verdsettelse og kontroll av beholdning og varelager
  • Delta sentralt i årsoppgjør og revisjon
  • Videreutvikle internkontroll, rutiner, dokumentasjon og kontrollaktiviteter
  • Bidra til at etablerte rutiner, fullmakter og prosesser etterleves i organisasjonen
  • Bygge og vedlikeholde strukturkapital gjennom tydelige arbeidsprosesser, ansvarsdeling og dokumentasjon
  • Redusere personavhengighet og bidra til robuste og skalerbare økonomiprosesser
  • Bidra til videreutvikling og bedre utnyttelse av ERP- og rapporteringssystemer
  • Identifisere muligheter for standardisering, automatisering og effektivisering
  • Bidra i økonomirelaterte utviklingsprosjekter på tvers av konsernet
  • Være en faglig sparringspartner for kollegaer i økonomiteamet
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en erfaren og faglig trygg økonom som liker å ta ansvar for at tallene er riktige og prosessene fungerer godt.

 

Du er strukturert og nøyaktig, men samtidig pragmatisk og løsningsorientert. Du evner å gå ned i detaljene når det er nødvendig, samtidig som du ser helheten og forstår hvordan selskapsregnskap, produksjon, systemer, internkontroll og rapportering henger sammen.

 

Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:

  • liker en variert arbeidshverdag og et bredt ansvarsområde
  • er selvstendig, initiativrik og komfortabel med å ta faglig ansvar
  • er fleksibel og håndterer både faste prosesser og problemstillinger som oppstår underveis
  • tar eierskap, jobber åpent og følger opp oppgaver til de er løst
  • ser forbedringsbehov og tar initiativ uten å være avhengig av detaljerte bestillinger
  • liker å skape struktur og sikre at avtalte arbeidsmetoder faktisk etterleves
  • har forståelse for betydningen av gode rutiner, dokumentasjon og internkontroll
  • er opptatt av å bygge robuste prosesser som ikke er avhengige av enkeltpersoner
  • er nysgjerrig på systemer og hvordan teknologi kan brukes til å forenkle og forbedre økonomiarbeidet
  • liker kombinasjonen av operative oppgaver og mer langsiktig utviklingsarbeid

Vi ser ikke etter en person som kun ønsker å arbeide med én avgrenset del av økonomifaget. Stillingen har stor bredde og krever at du både kan gå ned i detaljene og løfte blikket, samt bidra der behovet til enhver tid er størst.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Høyere utdanning innen økonomi, regnskap, revisjon eller tilsvarende
  • Flere års relevant erfaring fra regnskap, revisjon, controlling eller finansiell rapportering
  • Solid regnskapsforståelse og erfaring med måneds- og årsavslutning
  • God forståelse for resultat, balanse og kontantstrøm
  • God systemforståelse og erfaring med ERP- og rapporteringssystemer, samt interesse for videre læring
  • Gode Excel-kunnskaper
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

Erfaring med konsernregnskap, budsjett og prognose, varelagervurdering, revisjon, internkontroll, Xledger, One Stop Reporting, Power BI, Power Query eller automatisering er en fordel.

 

Det viktigste er at du har et solid faglig fundament, tilstrekkelig erfaring til å ta et selvstendig faglig ansvar og et ønske om å bidra til å bygge en stadig bedre og mer robust økonomifunksjon.

Vi tilbyr
  • En sentral seniorrolle i økonomifunksjonen i et norsk havbrukskonsern
  • Et bredt ansvarsområde på tvers av selskaper, produksjonsområder og økonomiprosesser
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og påvirkningsmulighet
  • Mulighet til å påvirke hvordan økonomiprosesser, internkontroll, systemer og rapportering videreutvikles
  • En sentral rolle i å bygge robuste arbeidsprosesser og strukturkapital i organisasjonen
  • Tett samarbeid med økonomisjef/CFO, Business Controller, regnskapsførere og ledere i konsernet
  • Moderne systemer og gode muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Mulighet til å kombinere regnskapsfaglig arbeid med system- og prosessutvikling
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Arbeidssted: Sandviken, Bergen

  • Hjemmekontor: Delvis, etter avtale

     

Har du spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte vår rekrutteringsrådgiver i Lederhuset AS, Bjarne Jacobsen.

Knutsen OAS Shipping AS is a fully integrated shipping company. We do shipping operation, newbuilding supervision, chartering and project development in-house. The head quarter is in Haugesund, Norway.

title: Green Office - Project Coordinator
description:
About the position 

The UiO Green Office is looking for a student employee to help strengthen sustainability engagement across student life, education, and research at the University of Oslo.

This position is part of two of our working groups; Education & Research and Dissemination & Dialogue work. They work to connect students, student organizations and researchers to strengthen sustainability engagement at UiO.


Qualifications

Previous experience or education related to organizational work or education is an advantage. You must be enrolled as a UiO student throughout 2026 and 2027

Key responsibilities and tasks include:

  • Collaborating with the Student Parliament, student organizations and other sustainability initiatives.
  • Promoting sustainability-related education and research at UiO
  • Contributing to larger events such as the SDG conference, theme weeks and national and international Green Office networks
