Your responsibilities will include:

    Pricing and underwriting of insurance products
    Profitability analysis and performance monitoring
    Identifying and analysing new market segments and business opportunities across Spain and broader European markets.
    Developing analytical tools, models and automation solutions
    Forecasting and project management
    Working with and analysing large datasets
    Supporting strategic and commercial decision-making through data-driven insights

The role is varied and combines advanced analytics with commercial understanding. You will work extensively with tools such as Excel, SQL, R and Python.

About You

We are looking for an analytically and mathematically strong individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced, performance-oriented environment. You are comfortable taking responsibility, working independently and challenging both yourself and established ways of working.

We believe you have:

    A Master´s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science or a similar quantitatively focused field
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with excellent academic results

title: Commissioning HSE Lead/Manager
description:
Job Summary: The HSE Commissioning Lead / Manager will report to the Overall Commissioning, Start-Up (CSU) Manager and is responsible for developing and implementing HSEQ standards and procedures to ensure a safe and compliant commissioning process. This full-time role will require extensive experience in HSEQ management through construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, and plant performance testing phases, with an emphasis on HSE in transition, Permit to Work (PTW), and incident prevention.

Key Responsibilities:

    HSE Leadership: Provide strong leadership and guidance on all HSEQ matters during the commissioning and start-up phases, fostering a culture of safety and compliance across the project.
    HSEQ Planning: Develop and implement HSEQ policies, plans, and procedures specific to commissioning and start-up activities, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
    Risk Assessment: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and hazard identification (HAZID) for all pre-commissioning, commissioning, and start-up activities to minimize risks and prevent incidents.
    Permit to Work (PTW): Oversee the Permit to Work system, ensuring strict adherence and proper training for all personnel involved in commissioning and start-up. Ensure all PTW documentation is accurate and aligned with HSE standards.
    HSE Transition Management: Manage HSE aspects of transition activities from construction to commissioning to start-up, ensuring seamless transitions and compliance with all safety requirements.
    Incident Investigation: Lead or support investigations into any HSE incidents, conducting root cause analysis and developing corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
    Training and Awareness: Deliver HSEQ training, inductions, and safety briefings to personnel involved in commissioning, ensuring a thorough understanding of project-specific HSE requirements and procedures.
    HSEQ Audits and Inspections: Conduct regular HSE audits, inspections, and site visits to identify non-compliance, promote safe practices, and ensure adherence to HSEQ protocols.
    Documentation and Reporting: Maintain detailed records and documentation of all HSEQ activities, including incident reports, audit findings, and training records. Generate regular HSE performance reports for the CSU Manager and project stakeholders.
    Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve HSEQ practices and processes within the commissioning phase, driving the adoption of innovative safety solutions and best practices.

Technical Skills:

    In-depth knowledge of HSEQ standards and regulations for commissioning and start-up
    Proficiency in PTW systems and risk assessment tools, including Bowtie, FMEA, or HAZOP
    Expertise in HSEQ management systems and software, such as Enablon, Intelex, or SAP EHS
    Strong technical writing and reporting skills for HSEQ documentation and incident investigations
    Familiarity with ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001 standards

Preferred Qualifications/Skills:

    Advanced qualifications in HSEQ, Occupational Health and Safety, or a similar field
    Certification in HSEQ (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, ISO Lead Auditor)
    Extensive experience in green energy or hydrogen-based projects
    Proficiency in Swedish is advantageous but not essential
    Strong background in safety transition management and incident investigation techniques

Qualifications:

    Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field or Advanced qualifications in HSEQ or a similar discipline are preferred.
    Minimum +15 years of experience in HSEQ management within large industrial projects, with a focus on construction, commissioning, and start-up.
    Extensive knowledge of industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices in HSEQ for commissioning and start-up environments.
    Expertise in Permit to Work (PTW) systems, risk management, incident investigation, and HSE transition management.
    Proven ability to implement HSEQ policies, deliver training, and foster a strong safety culture in fast-paced project settings.
    Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills, with the ability to engage and motivate multidisciplinary teams.
    Proficiency in HSEQ management systems, documentation, and reporting tools.

Fluent in English; proficiency in Swedish is an asset but not mandatory.

title: Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer
description:
The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report directly to the Overall Commissioning, Start-Up (CSU) Manager and will be responsible for overseeing the commissioning, start-up, and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems. This full-time role will require extensive expertise in mechanical equipment, both static and rotating along with piping systems and a deep understanding of nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing, and related commissioning activities, It will also require exceptional organizational, technical, and leadership skills to ensure successful project completion and handover while managing all aspects of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, and commissioning activities per industry standards and project objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

    Project Leadership: Lead the commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical and piping systems, working closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure smooth project execution.
    Commissioning Planning: Develop and execute detailed commissioning plans, schedules, and procedures for all mechanical and piping systems, including nitrogen-helium leak testing, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities.
    Technical Oversight: Provide expert guidance on mechanical equipment and piping processes, such as flange management, piping testing, and system performance testing, ensuring adherence to industry standards and project specifications.
    Testing and Inspection: Oversee and conduct testing and inspections of piping systems and mechanical equipment to verify integrity and compliance with safety and quality requirements.
    Documentation: Maintain accurate records and documentation of commissioning activities, including test reports, checklists, punch lists, and as-built drawings.
    Problem Resolution: Identify and troubleshoot issues related to mechanical and piping systems during the commissioning phase, working closely with engineering and operations teams to implement solutions.
    Safety and Compliance: Ensure that all commissioning activities comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations, promoting a strong safety culture across the project.
    Performance Testing: Lead plant performance testing and assist in final handover to the operations team, ensuring all systems meet project performance criteria.
    Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with the CSU Manager, project engineers, and other stakeholders to align commissioning activities with overall project objectives and timelines.
    Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process optimization and improvements in commissioning practices, contributing to the project's success.



    Technical Skills:

    In-depth knowledge of mechanical systems and piping processes
    Proficiency in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing, and related procedures
    Familiarity with specialized software for piping design and commissioning, such as SmartPlant or Hexagon Piping
    Strong knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (ASME, ANSI, API)
    Excellent project management skills, including scheduling, resource allocation, and budget management.
    Certifications in piping and mechanical systems (eg, API 570, ASME B31.3)



Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or similar experience gained in a related field. A master's degree is advantageous as is Project Management experience.
    Minimum 10 years of experience in commissioning mechanical and piping systems, with a strong track record in large industrial projects.
    Expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, and plant performance testing.
    Familiarity with green hydrogen processes and/or green steel production is a plus.
    Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements for mechanical and piping systems.
    Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
    Strong communication and leadership abilities, with the ability to guide and mentor team members.

title: Instrument and Controls Commissioning Lead Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

The Lead Instrument and Controls Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the commissioning, start-up, and optimization of all instrumentation and control systems in the Stegra Hydrogen to Green Steel Project. Reporting directly to the Overall CSU Manager, this role requires extensive experience with major control systems, interfacing with various package types, protocols such as Modbus and Profibus, and advanced troubleshooting and tuning capabilities. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the plant's instrumentation and control systems are fully operational, tuned, and optimized to support green steel production.

Key Responsibilities:

Commissioning Leadership:

    Lead all commissioning activities related to instrumentation and controls, ensuring compliance with project specifications and quality standards.
    Coordinate with multi-disciplinary teams, including mechanical, electrical, and process engineers, to ensure smooth integration of control systems.

System Interface Management:

    Oversee the configuration and integration of major control systems (eg, DCS, PLC, SCADA) and communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, and Ethernet/IP.
    Manage the interfaces with various package types, ensuring compatibility and seamless communication across systems.

Instrumentation Commissioning:

    Oversee commissioning of instrumentation equipment, including calibrations, loop checks, and functionality tests.
    Ensure accuracy in instrument loop tuning to optimize process control and plant operations.

Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution:

    Identify and resolve design and operational issues related to instrumentation, control loops, and process equipment.
    Provide technical support for complex troubleshooting, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Process Tuning and Optimization:

    Perform plant and process tuning to ensure optimal performance and efficiency across control systems.
    Lead testing, validation, and performance tuning of plant processes, utilizing advanced automation techniques.

Documentation and Reporting:

    Maintain comprehensive documentation of commissioning activities, test results, and instrument performance tuning.
    Prepare detailed reports for CSU Manager and project stakeholders, summarizing commissioning progress and technical issues.

Safety and Compliance:

    Ensure that all commissioning activities comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations.
    Promote a strong safety culture, implementing best practices and ensuring that all personnel follow established HSE protocols.

Stakeholder Collaboration:

    Liaise with control system vendors, contractors, and internal teams to align commissioning activities with project objectives.
    Provide technical support and guidance to stakeholders, ensuring control system requirements are met throughout commissioning and start-up.

Technical Skills:

    Control Systems Expertise: In-depth knowledge of major control systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA), including configuration, tuning, and troubleshooting.
    Communication Protocols: Extensive experience with communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, HART, and Ethernet/IP for system interfacing.
    Instrument Tuning and Calibration: Proficient in tuning instrument loops for temperature, pressure, flow, and level control to optimize process efficiency.
    Troubleshooting and Problem Solving: Advanced troubleshooting skills for resolving design, configuration, and operational issues with instrumentation and controls.
    Project Management: Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, and resource allocation for commissioning activities.
    Software Proficiency: Familiarity with relevant control and automation software tools (eg, Honeywell, Siemens, Rockwell, Emerson, Yokogawa systems) and industry-specific tuning software.

Preferred Qualifications:

    Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or extensive industry-related discipline experience. A master's degree is advantageous.
    Professional Certifications: Certification in controls systems or automation engineering (eg, ISA CCST, IEC 61508).
    Experience: At least 10-15 years of experience in commissioning instrumentation and control systems for large industrial projects.
    Green Energy Experience: Experience in hydrogen or green energy projects is highly desirable.
    Language Skills: Fluent in English; proficiency in Swedish is beneficial but not essential.
    Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with standards such as IEC, ISA, ANSI, and other relevant regulations.

title: Master Thesis on Adaptive Distributed Control of Grid-Forming BESS
description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:    

BackgroundThe increasing penetration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) has accelerated the transition toward sustainable transportation and resilient electrical grids. Modern BESS installations are evolving into modular systems composed of multiple battery systems and multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs). Current hierarchical control architectures enable coordinated operation, it also introduces communication dependency, latency and scalability challenges. This type of architecture relies on hierarchical communication between the Energy Management System (EMS), local BESS controllers and individual PCS controllers. Multiple communication layers may introduce delays, synchronization errors and reduced dynamic performance in the grid-forming operation. Communication failures or packet loss can degrade power sharing, frequency regulation and transient stability.

     Research Question  

The objective of this master thesis is to develop and validate an adaptive distributed control strategy for modular grid-forming Battery Energy Storage Systems comprising multiple parallel Power Conversion Systems (PCSs) and multiple Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESSs). The proposed solution should reduce communication dependency, improve dynamic performance during power dispatch, enhance robustness against communication failures and delays, and provide a scalable control architecture suitable for future large-scale energy storage systems.







Objectives




    Reduce dependency on hierarchical communication.  
    Improve dynamic response during power dispatch.  
    Maintain accurate active/reactive power sharing.  
    Improve scalability for future modular BESS installations.  
    Develop and evaluate virtual impedance control to reduce circulating currents caused by   voltage, phase, and impedance mismatches among parallel PCSs.  

     Scope Of Work  


    Conduct a literature review on grid-forming converters, Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control, hierarchical and distributed control architectures for modular BESSs. Review the limitations of hierarchical communication, the motivation for adaptive control under varying operating conditions, and the applicability of Model Predictive Control (MPC) for predictive power sharing and constraint handling. [Weeks 1-4]  
    Develop a hierarchical grid-forming control model for multiple parallel PCSs and BESSs, including communication-based power dispatch, power-sharing control, and virtual impedance control. This model will serve as the reference for performance comparison. [Weeks 5-12]  
    Design and implement a distributed adaptive control strategy that reduces dependence on hierarchical communication while maintaining stable grid-forming operation, accurate active/reactive power sharing, and robust performance under communication delays and failures. If appropriate, investigate MPC to improve predictive power dispatch and constraint management. [Weeks 13-21]  
    Validate the proposed control strategy in MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS and/or PSCAD under representative operating scenarios, including load variations, communication delays, communication failures, and grid disturbances. [Weeks 22-26]  
    Compare the proposed distributed control with the baseline hierarchical controller using performance metrics including active/reactive power-sharing accuracy, frequency and voltage deviations, settling time, circulating current, communication bandwidth, and overall system robustness. [Week 27-29]  

     Candidate Competencies  


    Two MS students with the solid backgrounds in electrical engineering, with basic knowledge of power electronics, control systems, and power systems  
    Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar simulation tools like PSCAD or DIgSILENT is desirable.  
    Knowledge or previous experience in grid-connected converter control, BESS/PCS systems, adaptive or distributed control, and power-system stability is considered a merit.  

     Ready for the next move?  

Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today!

    A collaborative international environment where your ideas and initiatives can make a real difference

title: Primus-Silva - Junior Content Creator / Junior Content Designer
description:
. Founded in Sweden, Primus and Silva have been developing quality outdoor gear for multiple generations. Primus is known for designing and delivering stoves and gear for backcountry and outdoor kitchens everywhere. Silva provides products that make outdoor adventure safe and accessible with compasses, headlamps, running vests and accessories. Currently, Primus and Silva are focused on providing innovative, sustainably minded and performance orientated outdoor equipment for world class athletes and everyday adventurers. The Primus and Silva brands are sold in more than 60 countries worldwide.

Starta din kreativa karriär med två starka outdoorvarumärken

Vill du starta din kreativa karriär i outdoorbranschen? Primus och Silva söker nu en Junior Content Creator / Junior Content Designer som kommer vara med och utveckla hur två starka svenska outdoorvarumärken syns och kommunicerar. Här får du kombinera foto, film, grafisk design och digital marknadsföring och vara med hela vägen – från idé och produktion till färdigt material och publicering.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat marknadsteam och får arbeta nära erfarna kollegor inom content, design, e-handel och produktutveckling, samtidigt som du får stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att utvecklas. Primus och Silva är två svenska outdoorvarumärken med lång historia och produkter som säljs på över 60 marknader.

Om rollenSom Junior Content Creator / Junior Content Designer blir du en viktig del av vårt marknadsteam och arbetar med att skapa och designa innehåll för både Primus och Silva. Du kommer att arbeta brett över olika kanaler, målgrupper och format och anpassa innehållet utifrån våra varumärkesplattformar och kampanjplaner.

Rollen kombinerar kreativ produktion, grafisk formgivning och innehållsskapande. Du arbetar med material för digitalmarknadsföring och e-handel, men också med trade marketing för våra återförsäljare, mässor, event och butiksmiljöer. Du kommer också att vara ute och skapa eget content. Det kan handla om att hitta en bra plats i närområdet, hitta rätt ljus och miljö och på egen hand fotografera eller filma innehåll för våra kanaler.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    Skapa kreativa annonser och material för performance marketing.
    Designa och producera innehåll för webb, e-handel, landningssidor, nyhetsbrev och digitala kampanjer.
    Ta fram digitalt och fysiskt trade marketing-material för återförsäljare, mässor, event och butiksmiljöer.
    Skapa kundanpassat kampanjmaterial för olika marknader och återförsäljare.
    Planera, fotografera, filma och redigera enklare innehåll för sociala medier, kampanjer och e-handel.
    Stötta Social Media Manager med innehåll till våra sociala kanaler.
    Ansvara för struktur och löpande underhåll av vår digitala bild- och innehållsbank (DAM).
    Anpassa innehåll och design för olika kanaler, målgrupper och marknader.
    Delta och skapa behind-the-scenes-content vid foto- och filminspelningar, produktlanseringar, mässor, event och andra marknadsaktiviteter.
    Säkerställa att innehåll och design följer Primus och Silvas olika visuella identiteter.
    Samarbeta nära marknads-, e-handels- och produktteam samt externa partners.

Du kommer att arbeta med två varumärken med olika identiteter och målgrupper, men med en gemensam passion för outdoor. Det ställer krav på att du både kan förstå skillnaderna mellan varumärkena och samtidigt skapa innehåll som känns relevant, inspirerande och äkta.

Din profilVi söker dig som är kreativ, nyfiken, gillar tempo och att få saker gjorda. Du har ett starkt visuellt öga och trivs med att både skapa och utveckla content. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – viktigare är att du vill lära dig och utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna kollegor.

Du är i början av din karriär men vi tror att du:

    Har ett genuint intresse för outdoor.
    Har 1-2 års erfarenhet av content och design, alternativt relevant utbildning och portfolio.
    Kan fotografera, filma och redigera enklare innehåll.
    Har erfarenhet av digital marknadsföring och sociala medier.
    Kan ta eget ansvar i att utveckla och testa olika koncept, vinklar och copy för performance marketing.
    Har ett öga för form, färg, bild och detaljer.
    Är bekväm i exempelvis Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma och/eller Canva.
    Är strukturerad och kan hantera flera projekt och deadlines samtidigt.
    Är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och vill utvecklas i din roll.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Shopify eller andra e-handelsplattformar. Vi ser också gärna att du själv är aktiv inom exempelvis löpning, vandring, camping, orientering, skidåkning eller andra outdooraktiviteter.

Vad erbjuder Primus-Silva?Hos Primus-Silva får du arbeta med två starka svenska outdoorvarumärken och vara en del av ett engagerat marknadsteam med erfarna kollegor inom varumärkesbyggande, content, design, marknadsföring och e-handel.

Du får stort eget ansvar, arbeta brett med content, design och digital marknadsföring och samtidigt utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna kollegor. Vi erbjuder en prestigelös miljö med korta beslutsvägar, där idéer får ta plats och där du får vara med hela vägen från idé till färdig produktion.

Rollen är baserad på Primus-Silvas kontor i de historiska industrilokalerna i Bromma och kan innebära en del resor.

title: ASIC Design Engineering Manager, Lund
description:
Lead the Next Generation of ARTPEC™ Innovation! High-quality, innovative SoC/ASIC designs are critical to Axis's continued growth and future success. As we push the boundaries of cutting-edge technology with demanding requirements for low power, high performance, and security, we're expanding our ASIC department to meet the evolving challenges of next-generation data processing.

Latest news on Axis SoC:
https://newsroom.axis.com/tag/artpec

What is Axis?

Axis is a fast growing and highly innovative company that offers intelligent security solutions. We are market leaders in network and surveillance cameras and are using this as the core around our solutions to create a safer and smarter world. Our success is largely due to our highly skilled staff and our strong culture of daring to succeed and allowing ourselves to constantly break new ground. The people here at Axis are innovative, dedicated and energetic and for us it is not just about creating products - we form and shape industry leading solutions giving highest values to our customers.

Now we are looking for a passionate leader to head our ASIC Design team.

What will I do?

As the Engineering Manager you will have overall responsibility for the ASIC Design team.

    You will lead, coach and develop a team of highly skilled ASIC and FPGA engineers, creating a collaborate environment for people to perform, grow and take ownership. You will build a strong and inclusive team culture, set clear expectations and priorities, and support both experienced experts and emerging talents in their development.
    You are comfortable leading highly experienced specialists and creating the arena for them to succeed. You know when to provide direction, when to challenge and when to step back and let the experts lead.
    You will work close with your project manager and the Technology department to develop the next generation of ARTPECs, driving strategic technical direction and ensuring alignment with our product roadmap and future vision.
    You will do the planning, budgeting, resource allocation and day-to-day operations, ensuring optimal team performance, project delivery, and efficient resource utilization across multiple complex ASIC development cycles.
    You will be part of dynamic and expanding management teams in the ASIC and in the Technology departments, contributing to strategic decision-making and shaping the future direction of hardware innovation at Axis.
    You will lead and support organizational, methodology and process development, spearheading advancements in our design methodologies, tools, and processes to maintain our cutting-edge capabilities and efficiency.
    You will participate in cross functional project steering groups representing the ASIC team and ensuring seamless integration and collaboration with broader product development initiatives.
    …and depending on your interests and ambitions maybe even more?

Who are we looking for?

We seek a visionary leader with a profound passion for both cutting-edge technology development and empowering high-performing engineering teams. You thrive on fostering a stimulating, creative, and collaborative environment.

With a track record in technically demanding landscapes, you confidently provide architectural oversight and strategic vision, successfully navigating the complexities of advanced R&D environments.

Parallel to managing your own team we want you to have an enthusiasm for active participation in our leadership team to drive strategic initiatives, cross-functional alignment, and foster a healthy, unified culture across the entire multi-site department.

You are an ambitious and initiative-taking person that has good leadership skills with the ability to motivate the people around you and visualize the direction going ahead.

You have previous experience leading engineering teams as a team lead, project manager or formal people management.

The ASIC Design team

Your team, the core of our ARTPEC innovation, is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing the sophisticated hardware modules that provide Axis with an undeniable competitive edge. We tackle complex challenges in real-time image processing, advanced video compression, and state-of-the-art computer vision, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in surveillance technology using the latest techniques and tools.

The team also hosts the competence center for FPGA design at Axis. The FPGA designers assist in technology selections, methodology setup as well as participating in exciting product projects.

The team takes pride in delivering top-quality work using the latest techniques.

What Axis has to offer

Axis is an organization that values creativity and promotes teamwork and openness. With us, you will grow both personally and professionally within areas such as:

    Impact: Influence the next generations of ARTPEC and technology that is at the heart of Axis' products.
    Leadership: Lead highly skilled engineers in a culture where expertise, innovation and collaboration are highly valued.
    Strategic exposure: Be part of management teams and contribute to decisions shaping the future direction of hardware development.
    Growth: Develop your leadership, organizational and strategic capabilities in a global technology company. We have both Leadership and Mentorship programs supporting you in your journey.
    Culture: Work in an open and collaborative environment with strong technical communities and opportunities to build relationships across the organization.



Ready to act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. Would you like to grow with us?

Find out more from our recruiting Director Patrik Lislén on phone +46 46 272 1800.

We review applications continuously.

See you around!

title: PhD student in Environmental Science, Department of Thematic Studies
description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!

We are looking for a PhD student in Environmental Science to conduct qualitative, social science research on sustainable transitions in Swedish agriculture. The research focuses on how different stakeholders understand and communicate about sustainable financing, and how they collaboratively develop solutions in this area.

Your work assignments

As a PhD student, you will join a skilled, open and welcoming research group at Linköping University. Our researchers come from a range of backgrounds—including the social sciences, natural sciences and engineering—and we value diversity in experiences and perspectives. Together, we develop and apply innovative methods for environmental research, often in collaboration with other universities and a range of societal stakeholders.

The VERIFARM project, funded by Formas, is an interdisciplinary research project addressing the financing of and investment in the agricultural sector’s sustainable transformations. The project brings together expertise from the social and natural sciences within the broad field of environmental science, combined with industry knowledge from the banking sector and farmers’ professional expertise.

Your work will include investigating how different stakeholders understand, value and use information about the climate and biodiversity impacts of agriculture in relation to financing and investment. You will plan and conduct empirical studies, for example through interviews, focus groups, workshops and other dialogical and participatory methods. You will also carry out analysis as part of a larger interdisciplinary project team, in collaboration with farmers and representatives from the banking sector. The work will involve both collaborative and independent research.

The specific focus of your doctoral research will be developed within the overarching research questions of the project and in dialogue with the project team. The research questions, empirical material and methodological choices of your thesis will also be partly shaped by the knowledge, expertise and experience that you, as a PhD student, bring to the project. Depending on your background, your research may, for example, focus on sustainability reporting and ESG, financing and investment decisions, dialogue and collaboration between different stakeholders, or how environmental and sustainability information is generated, communicated and used in practice. Across these areas, the common focus is on how knowledge and dialogue can contribute to effective financing solutions for the agricultural sector’s climate transition and the promotion of biodiversity.

You will write scientific articles, present results at conferences, and participate in research education. As a PhD student you work on your thesis in the associated research project. Additional assignments such as teaching or other department tasks may be included up to a maximum of 20%.

Your qualifications

You have completed a degree at an advanced level, or completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which at least 60 higher education credits are at the advanced level, or otherwise acquired substantially equivalent knowledge. You meet the specific entry requirements if you demonstrate knowledge equivalent to 90 higher education credits (ECTS) in a subject of central importance to the field of Environmental Science. Relevant educational backgrounds for the advertised position include environmental science, environmental communication, business administration, or equivalent.

We are looking for someone who is motivated, curious and able to take responsibility for their own work, while also enjoying collaboration. Good command of both Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is required. As the position involves fieldwork, a valid category B driving licence is an advantage.

The following documented qualifications are required:

    Experience in data collection and analysis using qualitative research methods
    Knowledge of climate or sustainability transitions
    Strong scientific writing skills

The following documented qualifications are considered particularly advantageous:

    Experience with dialogical, co-creative and/or participatory methods, particularly focus groups or workshops, involving multiple types of stakeholders
    Knowledge of climate and/or sustainability transitions in agriculture
    Knowledge of biodiversity
    Knowledge of and/or experience with sustainability reporting, ESG, CSRD, corporate responsibility, or sustainability regulations
    Knowledge of financing, investment and the banking sector
    Experience of collaboration between academia and societal stakeholders
    Strong ability to communicate with people in international environments

Selection will be based on independent study projects or reports, certificates of professional experience, academic grades and interviews. In addition, the applicant should submit a preliminary outline of a potential doctoral research project within the framework described above (maximum 1 page). This outline will also form part of the basis for assessment, and applicants who are invited to an interview will be given the opportunity to further develop it.

The employment

When taking up the post, you will be admitted to the program for doctoral studies. More information about the doctoral studies at each faculty is available at https://liu.se/en/research/doctoral-studies

The employment has a duration of normally four years’ full-time equivalent. Extension of employment up to five years is based on the degree of departmental assignment. You will initially be employed for one year, after which your employment will be renewed.

Start date is January 2027/as soon as possible, based on agreement.

Salary and employment benefits

The salary of PhD students is determined according to a locally negotiated salary progression.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than November 2, 2026. Applications after this date wont be taken into consideration.

title: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence group at Luleå University of Technology develops autonomous robots for field use and has tested them in mines and other underground environments. We are now looking for a postdoctoral researcher to develop autonomy for teams of legged, wheeled and aerial robots in places with extended risk, such as underground mines and areas prone to rockfall. The work covers scene understanding with foundation models, navigation, and coordinated decisions within the robot team when communication is limited.



Subject description

Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.

  

Project description

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (RAI) group belongs to the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering. The group took part in the DARPA Subterranean Challenge with the CoSTAR team led by NASA/JPL. Its applications include robotics for mining, aerial inspection of ageing infrastructure, autonomy for space robotics and multi-robot search and rescue. More information is available at https://www.ltu.se/robotics.



Autonomous robots deployment in underground mines, areas prone to rockfall and other environments that are dangerous for people often need several robots working together. Communication between the robots is often intermittent, and each robot must interpret its surroundings well enough to judge risk on its own. Vision and language foundation models can support this kind of interpretation, but they rarely model the physics of the terrain or the dynamics of the robot. This position will develop methods that connect scene understanding, physics-informed navigation and coordination within the robot team, and validate them in real environments.

  

The research will focus on one or more of the following areas.



- Scene and context understanding with foundation models, for example vision-language models, in underground mines and areas prone to rockfall, including hazard identification and risk-aware traversability assessment



- Physics-informed foundation models for autonomous navigation, where learned models account for the robot's dynamics and the physical properties of the terrain



- Multi-robot collaboration over mesh networks, with shared mapping and coordinated decision making under intermittent communication



- Communication-aware planning of multi-robot missions that use 5G/6G infrastructure, where the robots plan their motion and tasks based on network coverage and capacity



- Experimental validation on legged, wheeled and aerial robots in underground and mining environments



Duties

The duties of a postdoctoral researcher are primarily research. The research has a substantial experimental part, with work on real robots and field experiments in mines and other underground environments. You will publish the results in international peer-reviewed journals and at major conferences. The position also includes co-supervision of PhD and master's students and taking part in applications for research funding from funding agencies, the EU framework programme and industry. Teaching may be included for at most one fifth of working time.



Qualifications

To be eligible for employment as a postdoctoral researcher, you must hold a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in robotics, automatic control, computer science, electrical engineering or a related subject. It is a merit if the doctoral degree was awarded no more than three years before the application deadline. Candidates who were awarded their doctoral degree earlier may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example different types of statutory leave.



You need a good knowledge of at least one of the following: robot perception, learning-based methods for robotics, multi-robot systems, or motion and mission planning. Previous work with experimentally verified results on real robots, in at least one of the research areas above, is required. You also need good programming skills in C++ and Python, and experience of ROS or ROS 2. Good oral and written English is required, since you will present the group's work in Sweden and abroad.



Experience of foundation models or vision-language models in robotics, of legged robots, of communication and mesh networking for robots, of wireless communication systems such as 5G or 6G, or of field experiments in underground environments is a merit.



Further information

This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years in total. The position is based in Luleå. The starting date is by agreement.



For further information about the position, please contact



Chaired Professor George Nikolakopoulos, +46 920-49 1298, mailto:geonik@ltu.se



Postdoctoral Researcher, Akash Patel, mailto:akash.patel@ltu.se



For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities and market conditions of the role.

Application

Also include a research plan of at most two pages that describes how you would approach one or more of the research areas above, and the names and contact details of two references. title: Project Manager External

title: Research associate: AI
employer: Stift The Stockholm Environment Institute, Sei
description:
The role combines hands-on evidence synthesis with the development and evaluation of AI-driven approaches to make evidence synthesis processes more efficient. You will work on manual evidence-synthesis tasks, while also using Python and/or R to build and validate machine learning, automation and AI-assisted workflows for searching, eligibility screening, and (meta)data extraction. Your work will also contribute to new meta-research on how, and under what conditions, automated and AI-based tools can speed up and improve evidence synthesis in the environmental field without compromising reliability, robustness or scientific quality.

Our team spans many disciplines and we welcome candidates from different backgrounds. If you have strong research and programming skills, want to help connect sustainability science with policymaking and are keen to learn evidence synthesis methods, we would like to hear from you.

Key tasks and responsibilities

Conduct and support manual literature searching, screening and (meta)data extraction for evidence synthesis projects, working with large volumes of scientific publications and grey literature (including bibliographic information and textual data).

Develop and maintain reproducible workflows in Python and/or R for screening, extraction, classification, quality-checking, cleaning and harmonization of textual and bibliographic data.

Apply and evaluate machine learning, natural language processing and LLM-based methods for text classification, information extraction and document analysis.

Validate automated and AI-generated outputs against human decisions, quantifying errors, uncertainty and potential biases.

Document methods, decisions and validation procedures to support transparent and reproducible research.

Work collaboratively with researchers across environmental, sustainability, climate, energy and social science.

Who you are

You are an early-career researcher with strong analytical and programming skills who enjoys working where sustainability research meets technology development – engaging with both the details of evidence synthesis and the computational methods that support it.

You are happy to do detailed manual eligibility screening and (meta) data extraction, while looking for opportunities to automate these processes and make them more efficient.

You have a background in, or strong interest in, sustainability or environmental research and enjoy learning from people with different disciplinary backgrounds.

You do not need to be an expert in every method or technology used in this role. We value someone who is curious, careful, quick to learn and a constructive team player.

The role would suit someone with:

    Programming and data analysis skills in Python and/or R, including version control with GitHub
    Experience handling large volumes of structured and unstructured text
    Practical experience applying machine learning, NLP or large language models to text classification, information extraction or eligibility screening
    An interest in evidence synthesis methodology
    Knowledge of, or interest in, sustainability or environmental research

Experience with more advanced AI development, such as model fine-tuning or deployment, is welcome but deep expertise in machine learning or software engineering is not required.

Experience with any of the following is highly desirable, but not required:

    Literature reviews, including systematic, scoping and rapid reviews
    Working with bibliographic datasets
    Literature eligibility screening or (meta)data extraction

Formal qualifications

    A master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, socio-environmental science, sustainability science or a related field.
    Early-career experience (1–2 years) in academic or applied research involving data analysis and AI/data-driven methods.

Personal skills

    Collaborative: comfortable working in teams and across disciplinary boundaries.
    Analytical and critical: able to assess evidence and critically evaluate AI-generated results.
    Systematic and data-oriented: enjoys turning complex information into reliable datasets.
    Clear communicator: able to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
    Curious and adaptable: interested in learning and applying rapidly developing AI methods.
    Quality-focused and responsible: attentive to research integrity, transparency, uncertainty and AI-related risks.

Additional information

You will join the International Climate Risk and Adaptation Team, which develops and applies pioneering research methods to define, describe, measure and communicate systemic climate risk in interdependent global systems. Drawing on diverse perspectives, its work spans quantitative and qualitative analysis, climate risk assessment, scenario and foresight development and AI-driven policy analysis.

Our offer

At SEI HQ we offer a stimulating position in an international environment. You will be part of a leading, multinational, multidisciplinary and multilingual team of experts in an organization where the well-being and development of our employees is of high priority. We value diversity and creativity at the core of what we do and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply. Our ambition is to provide a safe, professional, and creative workspace for all.

An employment with SEI HQ includes:

    Collective Agreement incl. occupational pension and many other collectively agreed benefits
    An annual healthcare contribution and additional benefits connected to promoting our employees’ wellbeing such as yearly health check-ups
    Opportunities for professional growth and development
    Flexible working hours, 37.5-hour workweek and a generous amount of vacation days
    Being part of tackling environmental and development challenges and developing solutions for a sustainable future for all.

Once employed, you must live in Sweden, preferably in the Stockholm area. It is not possible to work from another country.

How to apply

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than 26 October 2026, 23:59 Stockholm local time.

Applications must be written in English and submitted through our recruitment system. Please include:

    Cover letter highlighting relevant qualifications and experience (no more than two pages)
    Curriculum vitae (no more than four pages)

Please note that we screen all applicants manually. Incomplete applications will not be accepted.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Software engineering background
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Data / Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems and wants to work with modern cloud and data platforms for exciting clients across Stockholm

We’re looking for someone who can move comfortably between software engineering, data engineering, cloud architecture and distributed systems — designing solutions that are scalable, reliable and maintainable in real production environments.

What you'll work with

As a consultant at SwedQ, you'll work closely with engineering and product teams to design and build modern data-intensive systems. Depending on the assignment, that could mean building event-driven platforms, designing data architectures, developing backend services, improving large-scale data processing, or helping teams make better architectural decisions.

For this specific position, we are looking for someone with significant exposure to the Google Cloud platform and services such as:

    

BigQuery

    

Pub/Sub

    

Dataflow / Apache Beam

    

Dataproc / Spark

    

Cloud Storage

    

Cloud Run and GKE

    

Cloud SQL / Spanner

    

Vertex AI and the broader GCP data ecosystem

Beyond experience with individual cloud services, we value an understanding of the principles behind them and an interest in exploring different technologies and architectural approaches

That might include technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, Kubernetes, Snowflake, Databticks, dbt, Airflow, terraform or equivalent services across cloud providers.

What we're looking for

You have a strong software engineering foundation and several years of experience building production systems.

You're comfortable discussing topics such as distributed systems, scalability, event-driven architectures, batch vs. streaming, data modelling, storage technologies, APIs, observability, reliability and cloud infrastructure.

You probably have strong experience with Python, Java, Go, Kotlin, Scala or another modern engineering language, and you're comfortable working with SQL when solving data-intensive problems.

As a consultant

Technical ability matters, but consulting requires more than writing good code.

You'll work directly with clients, understand their problems, challenge assumptions when necessary and turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.

We therefore value people who:

    

Communicate technical concepts clearly

    

Enjoy collaborating with both engineers and stakeholders

    

Take ownership from problem to production

    

Are curious and continuously explore new technologies

    

Can balance technical excellence with business needs

    

Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping other engineers grow

Why join us?

At SwedQ, we’re an international team with people from different backgrounds, cultures and experiences — and we believe that makes us stronger, both as engineers and as a company.

We work with ambitious companies at the forefront of technology, giving you the opportunity to take on challenging projects, explore modern technologies and continue developing in the direction that interests you.

But work is only part of it. We genuinely enjoy spending time together — whether it’s after-work activities, trips, sports, dinners, gaming or just finding an excuse to have some fun as a team.

Most importantly, we listen to our consultants. We want to understand what motivates you, what you want to learn and where you want your career to go. Your interests and ambitions matter when we look at projects and opportunities.

We want SwedQ to be a place where you can grow professionally, work with great people and have a good time along the way.

title: Marketing Manager B2B Telecom SaaS
description:
VX Fiber | Stockholm | Full-time

VX Fiber is looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketing Manager to take ownership of our marketing and help us generate more qualified sales opportunities across our international markets.

You will turn commercial priorities into a focused marketing plan—and deliver it. From sharpening our product messaging and creating campaigns to building HubSpot workflows and improving our website, you will combine sound marketing judgement with practical execution.

As our main marketing owner, you will work closely with sales, product, leadership, agencies and marketing specialists.

The role

This role suits someone who enjoys both deciding what needs to happen and making it happen. You can identify the right audiences, explain a complex technology offering clearly, and build campaigns that move potential customers from initial interest to a meaningful sales conversation, experirence in technology marketing and ideally B2B telecommunicaitons is highly valued.

You will have ownership of marketing planning, delivery and improvement, with the opportunity to shape how marketing develops at VX Fiber.

What you’ll do

    Own the marketing plan. Translate business and sales priorities into clear audiences, campaigns, budgets and measurable objectives. Make deliberate choices about where to focus time and resources.
    Generate qualified demand. Plan, build and improve campaigns across our website, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels, taking responsibility for the content and execution.
    Work closely with sales. Agree target customers, qualification criteria and follow-up processes. Use feedback from sales conversations to improve targeting, messaging and lead quality.
    Lead product and solution messaging. Turn technical capabilities, customer insights and commercial benefits into clear positioning for network owners, service providers and other relevant buyers.
    Improve our website and content. Create and maintain product pages, campaign pages, customer stories and clear calls to action that help visitors understand our offer and take the next step.
    Equip sales with useful materials. Develop presentations, one-pagers, case studies and campaign assets that support customer conversations and help opportunities progress.
    Measure performance and act on it. Track conversion, lead quality, opportunities and marketing’s contribution to pipeline. Use the findings to improve campaigns and guide investment.
    Manage external support. Brief and coordinate agencies or freelancers, manage agreed budgets, and maintain quality and consistency across their work.

What you’ll bring

    Typically five or more years of relevant B2B marketing experience, with a track record of owning and delivering marketing activity.
    Evidence of generating qualified demand and supporting sales pipeline, with the ability to explain what you delivered and what changed as a result.
    Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform.
    Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, commercially relevant content.
    Practical experience with digital campaigns, website content, email marketing and LinkedIn.
    Confidence working with sales, product specialists and senior leadership, including challenging assumptions and recommending priorities.
    The judgement to balance ambition with available resources, and the willingness to produce work yourself.
    Fluent English. Swedish is a strong advantage, and additional languages are welcome.

Experience in B2B technology, telecoms, fibre, infrastructure, SaaS or connectivity would be particularly valuable. Familiarity with longer sales cycles, account-based marketing and managing external specialists would also be an advantage.

Why join VX Fiber?

You will have real ownership, close collaboration with colleagues across the business, and the opportunity to make a visible commercial contribution.

You’ll work in an international environment, helping customers understand technology that supports reliable connectivity and the development of digital infrastructure.

Practical details

    Employment: Permanent, full-time.

    Work eligibility: You must have the right to work in Sweden.
    Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

About VX Fiber

VX Fiber enables fiber network owners and service providers to consolidate, automate, and scale operations and wholesale business models.

Founded in Sweden during the early development of open access fiber network build, now with over 20 years of operations, service delivery and software development experience, we deliver an OSS/BSS SaaS platform, engineering services and operational services.

title: Postdoctor position available to study carbon assimilation in trees
description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

About the position

A post-doctoral position is available in the http://www.upsc.se/totte_niittyla at the Umeå Plant Science Center, Sweden to study carbon assimilation in trees using aspen as the model system. The position is part of a Swedish Research Council and NovoNordisk Synergy Projects. The latter is a collaboration between the Niittylä group, the https://cbmr.ku.dk/research/research-groups/moritz-group/?pure=en/persons/643429) at the University of Copenhagen and the https://www.helsinki.fi/en/researchgroups/plant-growth-dynamics at the University of Helsinki.

Trees represent the single most important carbon sink on the planet. An incomplete mechanistic understanding of carbon sequestration limits our ability of predict the capacity of trees to assimilate CO2 and optimise the production of sustainable wood derived materials and fuels. The project will adress this problem by investigating the connection between photosynthesis and downstream metabolic fluxes in leaves using a set of aspen mutants and isotope techniques.

The postdoc will collaborate between the three research groups, and will have the opportunity to pitch additional projects and integrate their own interests.

Your profile

Applicants should have a PhD in plant molecular biology, plant biochemistry or plant physiology. Biochemistry skills are important and previous experience on photosynthesis acclimation research in trees and Populus model systems are highly desirable.

English fluency and publication in peer-reviewed high-quality journal(s) is required.

As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology, SLU, Umeå.

Form of employment:

Temporary employment 24 months, with the possibility of extension depending on funding and project progress.

Scope:

100%

January 2027 or as agreed.

Application:

The application should include a letter of interest detailing research experience, achievements and publications and curriculum vitae.

Please submit your application before deadline 21 October 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

e\-guma entwickelt seit 2005 digitale Lösungen für den Verkauf und die Verwaltung von Gutscheinen, Tickets, Produkten sowie Guthaben\- und Geschenkkarten. **Deine Aufgaben**

* Als Project Manager begleitest du unsere Neukunden von der ersten Projektbesprechung bis zum erfolgreichen Go\-Live. Während des gesamten Onboardings bist du ihre zentrale Ansprechperson.

* Du berätst unsere Kunden bei Marketingmassnahmen und verkaufsfördernden Aktivitäten und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Angebote wirkungsvoll zu präsentieren und zu vermarkten.
* Du bringst deine Ideen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von e\-guma und unseren Prozessen ein.


**Das bringst du mit**

* Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung, bspw. im Bereich Tourismus, Hotellerie, Marketing oder im kaufmännischen Bereich.
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und gute Englischkenntnisse; ösisch und Italienisch sind von Vorteil.
* Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten.
* Freude am Kundenkontakt sowie eine klare, freundliche und lösungsorientierte Kommunikation.
* Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit hohen Mass an Eigenverantwortung.
* Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie Interesse an digitalen Produkten, technischen Zusammenhängen und individuellen Kundenlösungen.
* Sicherheit im Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen und Freude an der Konfiguration von Systemen.
* Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich zu vermitteln und Kunden kompetent zu schulen.
* Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Corporate Design; Kenntnisse der Adobe Creative Suite sind von Vorteil.
* Freude an der teamübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit.


**Das erwartet dich bei uns**

Bei e\-guma erwartet dich ein kollegiales, unkompliziertes und flexibles Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Du arbeitest im Homeoffice oder im Büro und profitierst von modernen Tools und flachen Hierarchien. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und unsere Produkte und Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten. Offene Kommunikation und eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit – ebenso wie das gemeinsame Miteinander bei regelmässigen Apéros und Teamevents. In deiner arbeitest du mit Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen zusammen – von Hotellerie und Gastronomie über Bergbahnen, Bahn\- und Schifffahrtsunternehmen bis hin zu Freizeit\- und Erlebnisbetrieben, Eventveranstaltern, Detailhändlern und Organisationen.

Operations Specialist \- Electronic Monitoring
==============================================

**Title: Operations Specialist**

**Salary:** competitive

**Hours:** Full\-time (100%), 42 hours per week (standard office hours, with some flexibility of commute), unlimited employment

**Vacation:** 25 days annual holiday, plus local legal bank holidays. An additional day off on your birthday.

**Start Date:** Now



If you’re motivated by meaningful work, strong customer relationships, and continuous learning, this role is for you. Help deliver technology that makes a real difference in public safety while building trusted relationships with key customers across Switzerland.



**Company Overview:**

Buddi is a fast\-paced, high\-growth UK based technology company that is a global leader in the design, manufacture and supply of equipment to the Criminal Justice Sector around the world.

Buddi has a long\-standing contract for its supply within Switzerland, and this is managed from our office in Lausanne.

Buddi has hubs, such as we have in **Lausanne, Switzerland** in many other parts of the world where that is necessary and improves the quality of our delivery and customer support.

Buddi’s parent company, Big Technologies PLC, is listed on the UK stock market and provides the financial resources and stability for the company to expand the supply of the equipment to new areas. Europe is a particular area for such expansion.



**Role Overview:**

As the **Operations Specialist**, you will join a small team in Lausanne and support our contract delivery within Switzerland. You may also support our wider operations in the region. Some flexibility with partially working remotely.

Fluency, written and verbal, in English language and either , French or Italian is a necessary requirement to support our Cantonal customers in Switzerland. Any other languages, at any level, would be beneficial though not essential.

From the Lausanne office you will manage the stock of equipment, including in country logistic supply via the postal service and provide the first line of direct customer support, whether through telephone or email engagement.

Alongside the day\-to\-day operations conducted from the office there will be a necessity for some travel to customer offices within Switzerland, specifically those that are or French speaking, for face\-to\-face meetings and delivery of some training relating to the equipment and software. Training will predominantly be supplied in Lausanne however it may also be preferable to attend Buddi’s UK office occasionally.

You will help in identifying and nurturing good practice, helping maintain strong customer relationships, and ensuring we meet and exceed our service delivery standards.

*
* **Key Responsibilities:**


* Provide operational support to help customers meet their Electronic Monitoring (EM) objectives, including timely and accurate equipment deliveries and technical advice.
* Support the delivery of training and knowledge sharing sessions, both upon request and by identifying areas for improvement.
* Support the completion of contractual obligations, such as the management of SLAs, KPIs, and the delivery of regular performance reports.
* Participate in regular account management meetings, capturing customer feedback and driving continuous service enhancements.
* Contribute to wider business development activities including supporting new customer implementations.




**Required Skills \& Experience:**

* Fluency in and English.
* A proactive, positive attitude with a passion for customer support and personal development.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Quick learner with the ability to understand and then explain Buddi’s products and services.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly in billing and data accuracy.
* Competency with office\-based IT tools and software (e.g. Microsoft Office suite)
* Eligibility to work in Switzerland.




**Desirable Skills:**

* Previous experience in direct customer communication.




**Additional Information:**

* Buddi supplies its equipment to criminal justice agencies, therefore data security, confidentiality and security vetting are contractual necessities.
* Willingness to achieve any available high\-level security vetting is required.
* Compliance with all data security and confidentiality requirements, whether from Buddi or our customers, is a necessity.




If you’re passionate about customer success, detail\-oriented, and eager to contribute to a high\-performing team, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Akutspital Pensum nach Vereinbarung für die Region Bachenbülach gesucht
description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Bachenbülach suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Bachenbülach

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Bachenbülach

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Bachenbülach liegt in der Zürcher Unterland und bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Arbeitsumgebung mit guter Verkehrsanbindung. Die Region ist über die Bahn und Autobahn A1 leicht erreichbar und garantiert eine schnelle Anbindung an Zürich und weitere Wirtschaftszentren. Das Dorf überzeugt durch seine Nähe zur Natur, ein ruhiges Arbeitsumfeld und günstige Gewerbemieten, was es für Unternehmen besonders interessant macht.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Bachenbülach

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Bachenbülach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Die Region Bachenbülach im Kanton Zürich verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern in Akutspitälern, da der Fachkräftemangel im Gesundheitswesen weiterhin anhält und flexible Pensen zunehmend gefragt sind. - Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Bachenbülach

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**

description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Schinznach suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Schinznach

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Schinznach

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Schinznach liegt im Aargau zwischen Aarau und Olten und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung an die SBB-Hauptlinie sowie die nahegelegene Autobahn. Sie profitieren von der zentralen Lage in der Deutschschweiz und den kurzen Pendelwegen zu größeren Wirtschaftszentren. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Mischung aus ländlichem Charakter und industriellen Arbeitsplätzen mit guter Infrastruktur.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst in Schinznach

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst in Schinznach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Die Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Schinznach ist derzeit sehr hoch. Als diplomierte Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann HF/FH haben Sie ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, insbesondere für leitende Positionen im Pflegedienst. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch spezialisierte Vermittlung und umfassende Unterstützung bei der Stellensuche in dieser gefragten Region.
